title: GRAPHIC DESIGNER & THUMBNAIL DESIGNER
description:
GRAPHIC DESIGNER & THUMBNAIL DESIGNER — TERMEDCASH



Position: Graphic Designer & Thumbnail Designer Work Arrangement: Remote Schedule: Part-Time / Long-Term Experience: Experienced designer with a strong portfolio required



ABOUT THE CREATOR



I am a full-time content creator building the TermedCash brand across YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Instagram, X,
, 
, and other platforms.



My content will include:



* Gaming

* Livestreaming

* DJing

* IRL content

* NYC/city exploration

* Food reviews

* Camera-based content

* Personality-driven videos



I am looking for a highly skilled graphic designer who specializes in YouTube thumbnails, vertical content thumbnails, and creator branding.



This is NOT simply a general graphic design position.



The most important ongoing responsibility is creating high-quality, attention-grabbing thumbnails that make people want to click.



You will also initially create a cohesive visual identity for the TermedCash brand across my social platforms.



I am looking for someone who understands the difference between:



"This looks good."



and



"This makes someone want to click."



Those are not always the same thing.



YOUR TWO MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



This position has two primary areas of responsibility:



1. INITIAL BRANDING PACKAGE



Create the visual identity and foundational graphics for the TermedCash brand.



2. ONGOING THUMBNAIL PRODUCTION



Consistently create thumbnails for my livestreams, VODs, long-form videos, and vertical content.



The initial branding work is primarily a one-time setup project.



Thumbnail design is the ongoing responsibility.



PART 1 — INITIAL TERMEDCASH BRANDING PACKAGE



When you are first hired, you will help establish a cohesive visual identity for TermedCash.



The goal is to create a recognizable brand that works across gaming, DJ, IRL, food, NYC, and other future content.



PROFILE PICTURES / AVATARS



Create a professional and recognizable profile-picture system for:



* YouTube

* Twitch

* Kick

* TikTok

* Instagram

* X

*

* 

* Other relevant platforms



The profile image must remain recognizable at very small sizes.



Provide appropriate variations/crops where necessary.



BANNERS & CHANNEL ART



Create platform-specific banners/headers for:



* YouTube

* Twitch

* Kick

* X

*

* Other relevant platforms as needed



Each platform has different dimensions and safe areas.



You are responsible for creating the appropriate version for each platform and ensuring important elements remain visible on desktop and mobile.



The banners should clearly belong to the same overall TermedCash brand.



BRAND VISUAL SYSTEM



The initial branding package should establish a repeatable visual language.



This may include:



* Primary color palette

* Supporting colors

* Typography/font recommendations

* Graphic elements

* Background treatments

* Shapes/patterns

* Image treatment

* Lighting/visual effects

* Avatar/profile treatment

* Thumbnail design principles

* Other useful brand guidelines



The objective is NOT to create a collection of unrelated graphics.



I want a cohesive design system that can be used consistently for years.



PART 2 — ONGOING THUMBNAIL DESIGN



After the initial branding package is completed, the primary ongoing responsibility will be creating thumbnails for new content.



There are FOUR distinct thumbnail categories you will be responsible for.



1. LIVESTREAM THUMBNAILS



I will regularly livestream gaming, DJing, and other content.



You will create thumbnails specifically for the livestream itself.



These thumbnails should:



* Immediately communicate what the livestream is about

* Be visually recognizable

* Match the TermedCash brand

* Stand out among competing livestreams

* Work well at small sizes

* Be appropriate for the specific game/content

* Not rely on a generic reusable template unless appropriate



The livestream thumbnail should be designed to attract someone who is browsing and d
 what to watch right now.



2. EDITED VOD THUMBNAILS



For selected livestreams, I will publish an edited version of the VOD.



You will create a separate thumbnail specifically for the edited VOD.



This is NOT automatically the same thumbnail as the livestream thumbnail.



The VOD thumbnail should reflect the content of the edited video and should be designed as a YouTube video rather than simply an archived livestream.



If the same visual concept makes sense for both, that's fine.



However, do not simply duplicate the livestream thumbnail without considering the purpose of the video.



3. LONG-FORM HIGHLIGHT THUMBNAILS



For each major highlight video, you will create a dedicated YouTube thumbnail.



These videos are designed to attract viewers who may have never watched my livestreams before.



The thumbnail should communicate the most interesting aspect of the video and create curiosity.



You will receive information such as:



* Video/topic

* Working or final title

* Finished video or relevant footage

* Screenshots/photos

* Important context



You are expected to use your own creative judgment to develop the strongest concept.



4. VERTICAL CONTENT THUMBNAILS



I will also produce vertical content for:



* YouTube Shorts

* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* Other vertical platforms when applicable



You will create vertical-specific thumbnails/cover images when the platform supports or benefits from them.



These should be designed specifically for the 9:16 format.



Do NOT simply take a 16:9 thumbnail and crop it into 9:16.



The composition should be intentionally designed for vertical viewing.



Important elements must remain visible and readable on mobile.



THUMBNAIL QUALITY STANDARD



Every thumbnail should be designed with one primary question in mind:



"Would someone who has never seen my content want to click this?"



A thumbnail should not simply be attractive.



It should communicate an idea, emotion, situation, or curiosity.



WHAT MAKES A GOOD THUMBNAIL



You should have a strong understanding of:



COMPOSITION



Directing the viewer's eye toward the most important element.



VISUAL HIERARCHY



Making it immediately obvious what the viewer should notice first.



CONTRAST



Making important elements stand out.



CURIOSITY



Creating a visual question or unanswered idea.



EMOTION



Using facial expressions, body language, situations, characters, objects, and environments effectively.



SIMPLICITY



Understanding that more elements do not automatically create a better thumbnail.



MOBILE READABILITY



Understanding that thumbnails are frequently viewed at extremely small sizes.



A thumbnail must still communicate its idea when viewed as a tiny image.



TEXT ON THUMBNAILS



Text should NOT automatically be used on every thumbnail.



If text is used:



* Keep it short

* Make it extremely readable

* Make it serve a purpose

* Make it complement the title

* Do not simply repeat the title

* Make sure it works on mobile



You should be equally comfortable creating strong thumbnails with or without text.



TITLE + THUMBNAIL STRATEGY



You must understand that the title and thumbnail work together.



They should generally complement rather than duplicate each other.



The title can communicate one piece of information while the thumbnail communicates another.



Together, they should create enough curiosity to encourage the click while accurately representing the video.



You should be comfortable suggesting improvements when you believe the title and thumbnail aren't working together effectively.



CONTENT VARIETY



TermedCash will not be limited to one type of content.



You should be comfortable designing thumbnails for:



GAMING



* Minecraft

* Fortnite

* Call of Duty

* Zombies

* Horror games

* New releases

* Challenges

* Multiplayer

* Other games



DJ



* DJ livestreams

* DJ performances

* Music-related content



IRL



* NYC exploration

* Food reviews

* Restaurants

* Events

* Challenges

* Lifestyle

* Travel/exploration

* Personality-driven content



The visual identity should remain recognizable while allowing the design to adapt to the specific content.



CREATIVE INDEPENDENCE



I do not want to micromanage every thumbnail.



I should be able to provide:



* Video

* Topic

* Title/working title

* Screenshots/photos

* Relevant context



And you should be able to develop a strong concept independently.



I want you to be comfortable saying:



"I think this image will work better."



"The thumbnail is too busy."



"We don't need text here."



"The title and thumbnail are saying the same thing."



"This expression communicates the idea better."



"The subject needs to be larger."



That type of creative judgment is highly valued.





DO NOT USE A SINGLE TEMPLATE FOR EVERYTHING



I want a recognizable brand.



I do NOT want every thumbnail to look identical.



Consistency should come from:



* Brand identity

* Typography

* Color treatment

* Composition principles

* Visual language



—not from simply changing the screenshot in the same template every time.



Each thumbnail should be designed around the specific content.



SOURCE MATERIAL & PHOTO MANIPULATION



Depending on the project, I may provide:



* Gameplay screenshots

* Video frames

* Camera photographs

* Personal photographs

* Logos

* Game assets

* Other relevant images



You should be comfortable with:



* Background removal

* Image compositing

* Photo manipulation

* Retouching

* Color correction

* Lighting adjustments

* Perspective adjustments

* Image enhancement

* Creating custom compositions



The final result should look intentional and professionally executed.



FILE & DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS



I primarily use Apple/Mac products.



You do NOT need to use Adobe software specifically.



You may use:



* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Affinity Photo

* Affinity Designer

* Figma

* Canva Pro

* Other professional design software



However, your final working files must be provided in a format that is editable and practical for a Mac-based workflow.



Preferred editable/source formats:



* Figma

* Affinity Photo/Designer

* PSD, if created in Photoshop

* AI, if created in Illustrator and compatible with the agreed workflow

* Other mutually agreed editable formats



If you use Adobe-specific formats, that is acceptable as long as the files can be opened/edited within the agreed workflow.



Before beginning long-term work, we will establish the exact source-file format we will use.



Finished assets should be delivered as:



* High-quality PNG/JPEG as appropriate

* Correct platform dimensions

* Correct aspect ratio

* High enough resolution for the intended platform

* Properly organized and clearly named



You must retain editable source files for future revisions when requested.



BRAND ASSET ORGANIZATION



Please maintain an organized library containing:



* Logos/assets

* Profile pictures

* Banner files

* Fonts/references

* Brand elements

* Thumbnail templates, if any

* Reusable graphic elements

* Final thumbnails

* Editable source files



Files should be clearly named and easy to locate.



I should not have to search through hundreds of files to find a specific thumbnail or asset.



THUMBNAIL REVISIONS



Reasonable revisions will be part of the workflow.



I may request changes such as:



* Different image

* Different composition

* Less text

* More/less contrast

* Larger subject

* Different expression

* Different background

* Different visual concept



You should be comfortable making revisions without taking feedback personally.



The goal is to arrive at the strongest possible design.



THUMBNAIL TURNAROUND



Because thumbnails are connected to an active content schedule, reliability is extremely important.



You should be able to communicate a realistic turnaround time and consistently meet it.



If you cannot meet a deadline, communicate that before the deadline, not afterward.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



I am NOT simply looking for someone who is:



"Good at Photoshop."



I want someone who understands content packaging and creator branding.



You should understand:



* YouTube thumbnails

* Click psychology

* Visual storytelling

* Composition

* Color

* Typography

* Branding

* Facial expressions

* Curiosity

* Contrast

* Simplicity

* Mobile viewing

* Creator branding

* Different content niches



You should be able to look at a video concept and think:



"What visual would make someone who has never heard of this creator want to click?"



REQUIREMENTS



REQUIRED



* Proven graphic design experience

* Strong YouTube thumbnail portfolio

* Strong image-editing/compositing skills

* Excellent knowledge of professional design software

* Strong understanding of composition

* Strong understanding of typography

* Strong understanding of color

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent English communication

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Ability to receive and implement feedback



STRONGLY PREFERRED



* YouTube thumbnail specialization

* Experience working with content creators

* Gaming thumbnail experience

* IRL/lifestyle thumbnail experience

* DJ/music thumbnail experience

* Personal branding experience

* Social-media branding experience

* Experience creating channel banners

* Photo manipulation/compositing

* Experience creating thumbnails without relying heavily on text

* Understanding of YouTube analytics/CTR

* Experience creating multiple thumbnail concepts



APPLICATION PROCESS



Please DO NOT send a generic application saying:



"Hello, I am interested. I am a graphic designer with 5 years of experience."



I want to see your actual work.



Please provide:



1. Portfolio



Send your strongest work.



Please prioritize YouTube thumbnails over general graphic design.



2. Your 5 strongest thumbnails





Send the five thumbnails you believe best demonstrate your ability to make someone want to click.



For each one, briefly explain:



* What the video was about

* What your design concept was

* What you wanted the viewer to notice first

* Why you believe the thumbnail works



3. Your strongest branding project



Provide an example where you created a visual identity for a creator, company, brand, channel, or project.



4. What software do you use?



5. Thumbnail experience



How long have you been creating YouTube thumbnails?



Approximately how many have you created?



6. Creator branding experience



Have you created profile pictures, banners, channel art, or other branding for content creators?



7. Availability

I

nclude:



* Hours available per week

* Days available

* Time zone

* Other current clients/projects



8. Pricing



Provide:



* Hourly rate

* Per-thumbnail rate

* Monthly rate



If you have different rates for different types of work, explain them.



9. Typical turnaround



How quickly can you normally complete:



* Livestream thumbnail

* VOD thumbnail

* Long-form thumbnail

* Vertical thumbnail



PAID DESIGN TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid design test using actual TermedCash content.



The purpose of the test is to evaluate your creative thinking, not just your technical ability.



The test may include:



PART 1 — LIVESTREAM THUMBNAIL



You will receive information about an upcoming livestream and create one thumbnail concept.



PART 2 — LONG-FORM THUMBNAIL



You will receive a video/topic and working title and create one YouTube thumbnail.



PART 3 — VERTICAL THUMBNAIL



You will adapt the concept appropriately for a 9:16 vertical format.



PART 4 — CREATIVE EXPLANATION



Briefly explain:



* Why you chose the composition

* What the viewer should notice first

* What creates curiosity

* Why you used or did not use text

* How the thumbnail and title work together

* Why your vertical design is different from the horizontal design



PART 5 — REVISION



I may provide feedback and request one revision.



This is intentional.



I want to see how well you can take creative feedback and improve a design.



The test will be compensated.



HOW YOU WILL BE EVALUATED



Your work will be evaluated based on:



1. CLICKABILITY



Does the design make someone want to click?



2. CLARITY



Can someone understand the basic idea quickly?



3. COMPOSITION



Does the viewer's eye naturally go to the important element?



4. CREATIVITY



Does the concept feel original rather than generic?



5. BRAND CONSISTENCY



Does it fit the TermedCash visual identity?



6. MOBILE READABILITY



Does it work when viewed very small?



7. TECHNICAL QUALITY



Are the image manipulation, typography, masking, lighting, and other details professionally executed?



8. CREATIVE JUDGMENT



Did you make smart decisions without needing to be told exactly what to do?



9. ADAPTABILITY



Can you create strong designs across gaming, DJ, IRL, food, and other content?



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



I am looking for a long-term creative partner, not someone who simply wants to make quick graphics.



The initial branding project will establish the TermedCash identity.



After that, the primary ongoing responsibility will be high-quality thumbnail creation and content packaging.



I want someone whose work improves as they learn:



* My personality

* My content

* My audience

* My visual identity

* What types of thumbnails perform well

* What doesn't work



I also want someone who can tell me when an idea can be improved.



You do not need to agree with every idea I have.



I value good creative reasoning.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with:



"I UNDERSTAND THE TERMEDCASH THUMBNAIL SYSTEM."



Then answer:



1. How many years have you been designing professionally?

2. How many YouTube thumbnails have you created?

3. What software do you primarily use?

4. What type of thumbnails are you strongest at?

5. Have you created branding packages for creators before?

6. Provide your 5 strongest thumbnails.

7. Provide your strongest branding project.

8. What is your hourly/per-thumbnail/monthly rate?

9. What is your availability?

10. How quickly can you typically complete a thumbnail?

11. What makes a thumbnail clickable?

12. When should a thumbnail NOT contain text?

13. What is the biggest mistake you see creators make with thumbnails?

14. How would you approach designing a thumbnail differently for a livestream versus a long-form YouTube video?

15. Watch this sample video/topic: [INSERT SAMPLE VIDEO/LINK]

Create a thumbnail concept for it and briefly explain your reasoning. 16. Look at your favorite thumbnail in your portfolio. If you had to improve it today, what would you change and why?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.

title: U.S. Bookkeeping & Accounting Professional
description:
Immediate Opening



We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients.



This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying.



What the Role Looks Like



For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client.



This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume.



We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you.



However, the position will not stay this way.



We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools.



As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients.



Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities.



What We're Looking For



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have:



* Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR

* Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality

* Good written and verbal English communication skills

* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment

* An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology

* A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses



Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours.



Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying.



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them.



Where This Position Can Go



We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices.



We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role.



As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit both of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute



In your video, please briefly tell us:



* Your accounting/bookkeeping background

* How much experience you have working with U.S. clients

* The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled

* Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule

* Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients



Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.

title: Senior QuickBooks Online Accountant
description:
I run a fractional CFO firm supporting U.S.-based service businesses, and I'm looking for an experienced accountant to help manage and clean up client books in QuickBooks Online.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping position.



I'm looking for someone who can be handed a set of books, review the P&L and balance sheet, identify what doesn't make sense, investigate the underlying transactions, and make or recommend the appropriate corrections.



What we are looking for



You should have significant experience with:



* Full-cycle accrual accounting

* QuickBooks Online

* Month-end close

* Balance sheet reconciliations beyond bank and credit card accounts

* Payroll entries and payroll liability reconciliations

* Loans, fixed assets, AR, AP and equity accounts

* Cleaning up inaccurate or poorly maintained books

* Reviewing financial statements for unusual or incorrect balances



Experience working with multiple U.S.-based accounting clients is required.** This is not a preference. If your experience is primarily with a single company or with non-U.S. accounting, this position is not a fit.



The right person doesn't just categorize transactions and reconcile bank accounts. You understand why an account balance is right or wrong and know how to investigate when something doesn't make sense.



To apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume.



2. A one-minute video introducing yourself. Briefly tell us about your accounting background, your experience working with multiple U.S.-based clients, confirm you can work US hours 9am to 5:30pm and what you're looking for in your next position. Please record the video from the location where you normally work.



Please keep the video to approximately one minute. I'm looking for clear communication and a professional remote-work environment, not a polished or professionally produced video.

We are building a professional trading operation focused on developing, testing, and optimizing high-performance stock trading strategies.

Collaborate with a team of trading professionals to develop and refine stock trading strategies.

Identify high-probability trading opportunities across U.S. equity markets.

Analyze market structure, price action, volume, momentum, and sector rotation.

Contribute to the creation of trading playbooks, rules, and execution frameworks.

Assist with strategy testing, validation, and optimization.

Evaluate trade performance and provide continuous improvement recommendations.

Maintain detailed trade documentation and research findings.

Participate in strategic discussions and provide independent market insights.

Work proactively with minimal supervision.

Required Experience

Equity Markets

Price Action Trading

Technical Analysis

Volume Analysis

Risk Management

Market Structure

Swing Trading

Day Trading

Momentum Trading

Breakout Strategies

Gap-and-Go Setups

title: Senior Apparel Technical Designer / Product Developer – Streetwear
description:
Senior Apparel Technical Designer / Product Developer – Streetwear



Full Time | Remote | Philippines



Compensation: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience



ABOUT THE ROLE



Starfish Supply Co. is looking for an experienced Apparel Technical Designer / Product Developer who can help take streetwear products from creative concept through tech pack, sampling, revisions, and production approval.



This is not primarily a graphic design position.



We already work with designers who create artwork and initial concepts. We need someone who understands how garments are actually constructed and manufactured and can translate those creative concepts into clear, factory-ready specifications.



You will work closely with our US creative team and our product development and production team in China.



Your strongest expertise should be apparel.



We also develop accessories, plush, toys, jewelry, packaging, and other merchandise. You are not expected to already be an expert in every category. Our China team and factories provide category-specific manufacturing knowledge.



For those products, your role is to understand the creative intent, organize specifications, ask the right questions, identify missing information, and keep development moving.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Apparel Technical Design



• Create and review production-ready tech packs



• Create technical flats in Adobe Illustrator



• Build measurement specifications and size grading



• Define construction details, tolerances, stitching, trims, fabrics, colors, and finishing



• Translate designer mockups into specifications factories can manufacture accurately



• Define artwork placement, sizing, and production requirements



• Identify missing or unclear information before sampling begins



Product Development



• Take products from concept through sampling and production approval



• Review samples and provide clear revision comments



• Compare samples against design intent, measurements, references, and approved specifications



• Identify construction, fit, material, color, printing, or embellishment issues



• Recommend practical solutions when a design is difficult, expensive, or unrealistic to manufacture



• Coordinate development changes with our China team



• Follow products through multiple sample rounds until approval



• Help ensure approved samples and specifications are correctly followed during bulk production



Streetwear Production



Our products may include:



• Screen printing



• Embroidery



• Appliqué



• Rhinestones and embellishments



• Garment washes



• Distressing and fraying



• Cut and sew garments



• Heavyweight hoodies and tees



• Custom fabrics and trims



• Oversized and fashion-forward silhouettes



• Specialty construction and finishing techniques



You do not need to know every technique listed above.



We are looking for someone with strong apparel fundamentals who knows how to research, ask questions, communicate with factories, and solve production problems.



Communication and Project Ownership



• Communicate clearly with our US creative team



• Turn creative feedback into clear production instructions



• Communicate with our China product development team



• Review factory photos, videos, measurements, and comments



• Identify potential problems before they become expensive production mistakes



• Keep multiple products organized across different stages of development



• Follow up proactively instead of waiting to be told every next step



• Participate in client or internal meetings when technical product knowledge is needed



• Help us improve our tech pack templates, standards, development systems, and documentation



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• 3+ years of professional experience in apparel technical design, product development, or a closely related apparel role



• Strong Adobe Illustrator skills



• Experience creating professional apparel tech packs



• Strong understanding of garment construction



• Experience with measurements, fit, grading, and tolerances



• Experience reviewing physical garment samples



• Understanding of fabrics, trims, stitching, printing, embroidery, washes, and embellishments



• Ability to understand both creative design intent and manufacturing limitations



• Strong written and spoken English



• Highly organized and detail-oriented



• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment



• Able to manage multiple products at different development stages



Streetwear, premium apparel, fashion, or creator merchandise experience is strongly preferred.



Experience communicating with overseas manufacturers is a plus.



YOU DO NOT NEED TO KNOW EVERYTHING



Your primary expertise should be apparel.



We also manufacture products such as plush, toys, jewelry, accessories, packaging, and other merchandise.



You are not expected to already know how every one of these products is manufactured.



Our China production team and factories will provide manufacturing expertise for these categories.



We need someone who can:



• Understand the designer’s intent



• Ask good technical questions



• Identify missing information



• Organize specifications



• Review samples



• Communicate changes clearly



• Keep development moving until the product is approved



WHO WILL DO WELL IN THIS ROLE



You will probably enjoy this role if you:



• Notice small inconsistencies other people miss



• Like solving manufacturing and construction problems



• Can look at a designer mockup and immediately start thinking about how it should actually be made



• Are comfortable telling a designer when something may not work and suggesting a better solution



• Can communicate clearly without needing constant supervision



• Like creating systems, standards, templates, and processes



• Take ownership of problems and follow them through until they are resolved



• Care deeply about accuracy and product quality



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not primarily a graphic design position.



Our designers create the artwork and overall visual direction.



We need you to help answer questions such as:



What fabric should this use?



How should this garment be constructed?



What measurements are missing?



How should the garment be graded?



How large should the artwork actually be?



How far should the artwork sit from the neckline or seams?



What production technique should be used?



What could go wrong during manufacturing?



What information does the factory still need?



Does the sample actually match the approved design?



How do we turn this concept into a product that can be consistently manufactured?



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position with 8 working hours per day plus a 1-hour meal break.



The schedule is designed to start at approximately 2:00 PM Los Angeles time and provide overlap between our US team, Philippines team, and China production team.



Philippines schedule:



During US Daylight Saving Time:

5:00 AM–2:00 PM Philippine time



During US Standard Time:

6:00 AM–3:00 PM Philippine time



This schedule includes a 1-hour unpaid meal break and 8 working hours.



Workdays are Tuesday through Saturday Philippine time.



Applicants should be comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis.



COMPENSATION



$1,500–$2,000 USD per month depending on experience, technical ability, and demonstrated product development knowledge.



Exceptional candidates with significant apparel technical design and product development experience may be considered above this range.



This is intended to be a long-term, full-time position.



There will be an initial paid evaluation period so both sides can confirm that the position is a good fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume



2. Your portfolio



Please include 2–3 examples showing apparel technical design, tech packs, measurement specifications, sample comments, or products you personally helped develop.



3. One short product development example



Tell us about one apparel product you personally helped take from concept through sampling or production.



Please briefly explain:



• What the product was



• What your responsibility was



• What problem or challenge came up



• How you helped solve it



Also include:



• Your expected monthly salary in USD



• Your earliest available start date



• Confirmation that you can work the schedule listed above



You do not need to write a long cover letter.



We care much more about seeing real examples of your work and understanding what you personally contributed.



ABOUT STARFISH SUPPLY CO.



Starfish Supply Co. works with creator, entertainment, and streetwear brands to develop and manufacture merchandise.



Our products range from premium apparel to accessories and specialty merchandise.



We are continuing to build stronger systems around technical design, sampling, product development, and production and are looking for someone who can become a key long-term member of our team.

title: YouTube Sponsorship & Monetization VA — We Need a HUNTER, Not Just an Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant | YouTube Sponsorships | Brand Partnerships | Affiliate Marketing | Research

We are looking for an experienced, highly motivated YouTube Sponsorship & Monetization Virtual Assistant to help us turn our growing YouTube presence into additional revenue.

We are Remove It Pros, an established demolition company in Florida. Our content covers real demolition projects, heavy equipment, tools, construction, junk removal, salvage, recycling, scrap, repurposing materials, and the business behind it all.

What We Need

This is NOT a basic YouTube VA position.

We don't need someone just to upload videos, answer comments, or schedule posts.

We need a HUNTER.

We want someone who can research the internet, study similar YouTube channels, identify companies spending money on creators, find the correct decision-makers, and uncover ways for us to monetize our audience.

Your job is to find opportunities and help us turn those opportunities into revenue.

What You'll Be Doing

- Find companies that would be a natural sponsorship fit for our YouTube content.

- Research brands already sponsoring similar YouTube channels.

- Identify the correct people responsible for influencer marketing, partnerships, sponsorships, affiliates, or creator programs.

- Find verified
s, LinkedIn profiles, contact forms, and other ways to reach decision-makers.

- Research affiliate programs, creator programs, brand ambassador programs, and product partnerships.

- Look for opportunities involving paid sponsorships, monthly sponsorships, affiliate commissions, free products, tools, equipment, and equipment partnerships.

- Research companies involving tools, heavy equipment, workwear, PPE, trucks, trailers, construction products, demolition equipment, technology, software, recycling, resale, and other industries that fit our audience.

- Watch competing and related YouTube channels and determine who is sponsoring them.

- Match potential sponsors to specific videos we're producing.

- Help write and send outreach.

- Follow up with potential sponsors consistently.

- Keep everything organized in our CRM/spreadsheets.

- Track contacts, conversations, offers, follow-ups, sponsorships, and revenue generated.

- Continually look for new ways to monetize the channel beyond normal YouTube advertising.

We're Looking for Someone Who...

Has excellent internet research skills and good written and spoken English.

You should be comfortable using YouTube, Google, LinkedIn,
, Instagram, company websites, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other research tools.

AI is encouraged, but we don't want somebody who simply asks AI for a list and sends it to us.

You need to verify your research and dig deeper when the easy answer isn't there.

You should be the type of person who can start with:

"Find companies that might sponsor a demolition video."



…and come back with:

"I researched 30 companies. These 12 are actively sponsoring creators. I found the marketing/partnership contacts for 9 of them. These 5 are the strongest opportunities, here's why, and I've prepared the outreach."



That's the person we're looking for.

Experience We'd Love to See

Previous experience with one or more of these is highly preferred:

YouTube sponsorships, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorship sales, lead generation, online research, brand outreach, or YouTube channel management.

Experience in construction, tools, equipment, automotive, trades, or home improvement is a plus, but not required.

How We Measure Success

We're not interested in somebody filling a spreadsheet with hundreds of random company names.

We're interested in:

Qualified opportunities → Correct contacts → Outreach → Follow-up → Conversations → Deals → Revenue

Ultimately, we want this position to pay for itself many times over.

IMPORTANT — How to Apply

Do NOT send us a generic virtual-assistant application.

Start your application with the words:

"I'M A HUNTER"

Then answer these three questions:

1. Tell us about your experience finding YouTube sponsorships, affiliate programs, brand partnerships, or similar revenue opportunities.

2. Have you worked with any YouTube creators or channels before? If so, tell us what you did.

3. TEST: Research our business, Remove It Pros, and give us 5 companies you believe could realistically be potential sponsors for our YouTube channel.

For each company, tell us why you selected them and whether you can find evidence that they work with creators, influencers, affiliates, or YouTube channels.

If you can also find the person or department we should contact, even better.

We're looking for someone who wants an ongoing position and can become an important part of growing the revenue side of our content.

If you're a researcher, a problem-solver, and most importantly a HUNTER—we want to hear from you.

*** About the Role ***

Aerospace, defense, and first responder are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Dedicated Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.



***On your portfolio: Send me real work, not volume. Do not send a reel, a montage, or a folder with fifty UGC ads, TikToks, and social cuts in it. A montage tells me nothing about whether you can structure a piece. I want links to complete finished videos, with the runtime stated, and a one-line note on what you were responsible for on each.



If you do not have long-form finished work, say so directly in your application. That is a fair answer and it will not get you thrown out. Padding the link with short-form to make the portfolio look full will.***



- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Full-Stack Digital Marketing & Web Development Specialist (Next.js, AWS, SEO, Ads)
description:
The Edgett Law Firm and Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law are hiring one hands-on specialist to personally develop, maintain, market, and improve our two Texas law firm websites. This is an execution role, not a position that primarily manages outside contractors. You must be comfortable working directly in code and AWS while also producing marketing content, design, video, and paid campaigns.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Website development and AWS

• Develop and maintain custom Next.js websites, including pages, components, layouts, forms, and integrations.

• Use Git branches, staging, testing, deployments, and rollback procedures. Troubleshoot broken pages, slow loading, failed forms, and deployment issues.

• Work directly with AWS hosting, uptime monitoring, security, backups, and recovery. Maintain mobile usability, accessibility, redirects, sitemaps, structured data, and site architecture.

• Document changes and keep all domains, accounts, source code, data, and creative assets under firm ownership.



SEO, local search, and content

• Audit both sites and personally implement technical and on-page SEO fixes involving crawlability, indexing, page speed, metadata, schema, internal links, and content quality.

• Research keywords and competitors for criminal defense and personal injury in our Texas service areas. Improve existing pages and build new practice-area, service, location, FAQ, and landing pages.

• Manage both Google Business Profiles, including categories, services, photos, posts, Q&A, and review responses. Improve visibility in traditional and AI-powered search without making ranking guarantees.

• Write, edit, design, publish, and measure original legal marketing content. Our prior two-site benchmark was up to 16 SEO-focused blogs monthly, subject to quality and an approved plan. Review and publish existing prepared landing pages and create new ones based on opportunity.

• Submit substantive legal content to an attorney for accuracy approval before publication.



Design, video, and social

• Personally create polished website graphics, page imagery, social assets, short educational videos, reels, captions, and AI-assisted video or avatar content as appropriate.

• Manage Instagram and Google Business Profile posting for both brands. Our prior two-site benchmark was 18–24 combined posts monthly. Keep approved reviews and testimonials current on the websites.



Automations, tracking, and reporting

• Build and test website forms, lead routing, notifications, and follow-up automations. Connect and troubleshoot GA4, Search Console, Google Business Profile, CallRail, MyCase, Attorney Fuel, and intake systems.

• Investigate missing calls, forms, messages, and attribution discrepancies. Verify that inquiries reach our team.

• Maintain a task board, content calendar, website change log, and campaign record. Provide a weekly report with completed work, live URLs, spend, search and site performance, leads by source, qualified leads, signed clients, issues, and next steps. Participate in two strategy meetings monthly.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Professional Next.js development and AWS production operations; strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, APIs, debugging, and performance skills.

• Proven hands-on technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, content writing, and publishing experience.

• Direct experience running Google Ads, Local Services Ads, Meta ads, and conversion tracking.

• Ability to personally produce branded designs and edit short-form video.

• Experience building CRM and lead-intake integrations and automations.

• Excellent written English for a U.S. audience. U.S. legal or competitive local-service marketing experience is strongly preferred.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Full-time remote role based in the Philippines, with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with our Texas team each workday. You must have a dependable process for urgent website, ad, or lead-delivery problems. Compensation is based on demonstrated skills and experience.



TO APPLY

Please send your résumé and expected monthly compensation in USD or PHP; links to two live websites you personally developed or maintained and their framework/hosting setup; a Next.js/AWS change you personally tested and deployed; one SEO result and one paid campaign you personally managed; a graphic and video you personally made; a lead tracking or automation example; your first-30-days priorities for two Texas law firm websites; and your working hours in U.S. Central Time. Clearly distinguish your own work from work done by a team.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent, clear, conversational English

• Easy for U.S. business owners to understand

• Confident, friendly phone presence

• Experience cold calling U.S. businesses preferred

• B2B sales or appointment-setting experience preferred

• Comfortable speaking with business owners and decision makers

• Able to follow a script without sounding like you are reading it

• Good at asking questions and having natural conversations

• Reliable internet and quiet working environment

• Coachable and willing to improve based on call recordings and feedback



This is NOT a customer service position. We are looking for someone comfortable starting conversations with business owners and generating interest but the ultimate goal of getting them to purchase a $19 paid full audit.



COMPENSATION



• $4/hour guaranteed base pay

• $1 for each complimentary Light Audit completed

• Earn Accelerators For $19 Full Paid Audits::

$4 for each 1-4 paid full audits completed  per day

$7 for each 5-9 paid full audits completed per day

$10 for each 10+ paid full audits completed per day.

• Additional bonuses when your prospects become paying customers of our monthly service 



$19 FULL AUDIT COMMISSION



1–4  Paid Full Audits: $5 each

5–9  Paid Full Audits: $7 each

10+ Pain Full Audits: $10 each

Example:



10 Full Audits = $100 commission

4 hours base pay = $16



Total = $116 for the 4-hour shift, before any $1 Light Audits are advant

VOICE AUDITION REQUIRED

“Hi, maybe you can help me out for a second...

5. Your hourly rate

6. Your availability and the U.S. time zones you can work

8. Approximately how many outbound calls you are comfortable making during a 4-hour shift

Not hundreds of leads.

The right opportunities.



Initially, your work will focus heavily on research: finding podcasts, communities, events, summits, partnerships, speaking opportunities and carefully selected prospective clients.



But I want to be transparent about the longer-term opportunity.

I am building a commercial team, not simply hiring a researcher.

If you prove excellent at identifying opportunities, understand the work deeply and demonstrate strong commercial judgment, there is potential for this role to grow into greater business-development and sales responsibility over time.



So I am particularly interested in someone who enjoys research but ultimately wants to grow commercially.



What you'll actually do

You will help me identify places where the right women already gather and conversations worth entering.

This may include:

- podcasts and interview shows;

- women's leadership and founder communities;

- exclusive summits, workshops and events;

- speaking and expert-panel opportunities;

- strategic partnerships and collaborations;

- carefully selected LinkedIn prospects;

- other trusted environments that could create meaningful commercial relationships.



You won't simply give me a list.

For every opportunity you recommend, I want to understand:

Why this? Why now? Why is it worth our time?

A small podcast with an exceptional audience may be more valuable than a large generic show.

A private community of 300 highly aligned women may matter more than an audience of 30,000.

One exceptional prospective client may be worth considerably more than 100 people who happen to match a demographic profile.



You need to enjoy figuring out the difference.



Once we decide an opportunity is worth pursuing

You may also:

research the correct person to contact;

prepare or submit approved pitches and applications;

coordinate bios, links and supporting material;

follow up;

track responses;

manage logistical communication;

and make sure promising opportunities don't quietly disappear.



You will not impersonate me.



High-trust relationship conversations, personal messages and sales conversations initially remain with me.

Your job is to create access, context and momentum.



Who I'm particularly interested in



You may currently work in:

business development;

partnerships;

sales development (SDR/BDR);

lead generation;

founder prospecting;

media or podcast outreach;

PR research;

influencer/creator partnerships;

community or event partnerships;

appointment setting;

or another commercially accountable role.



I care less about your job title than about how you think.



You should be able to research independently, notice opportunities, communicate extremely well in English, follow through without being chased and understand that commercial work is ultimately expected to create revenue.



Experience with commission, bonuses, pay-per-appointment, performance targets or another form of results-linked compensation is strongly preferred.



This probably isn't for you if...

Your primary experience is general virtual assistance, inbox/calendar management, Canva, data entry or administrative support.

It also isn't a good fit if your preferred prospecting method is scraping hundreds of contacts and sending everyone the same message.

I am looking for judgment, curiosity and commercial instinct.



The role begins small intentionally.

Initial commitment: approximately 8–10 hours per month

Base rate: US$8–$10/hour depending on experience

Commission: 5% of qualifying revenue directly attributable to opportunities or prospects you originate



If the work creates revenue and proves valuable, there is room for the role, responsibility and hours to grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Please don't send me a generic cover letter or simply attach your résumé.



I would like four answers.

1. Tell me about ONE prospect, partnership or commercial opportunity you personally discovered that someone else might have overlooked.

What did you notice?

Why did you think it was worth pursuing?

What did you do?

What happened?

Maximum 200 words.



2. Tell me about a time you received a “no”, rejection or non-response while doing sales, business development or outreach.

What did you do next?

I'm particularly interested in why you made that decision.

Maximum 150 words.



3. Tell me about the most commercially accountable role you've held.

How were you measured?

Was any of your compensation based on commission, bonuses, appointments, conversions, revenue or another performance measure?

What did you personally have to achieve?

Maximum 150 words.



4. A small research exercise

Imagine you discover these three possible opportunities for my business:

A. A well-known entrepreneurship podcast with 70,000 monthly downloads. It interviews successful founders and has featured several major names. Recent episodes are predominantly about marketing, scaling and investment.

B. A private paid community of 450 senior women executives, founders and consultants aged approximately 40–60. It hosts monthly intimate expert conversations. There is little public information about guest applications.

C. A women's personal-development summit with 15,000 registered attendees. It accepts speaker applications and promotes themes including confidence, wellness, relationships, spirituality and business.

I only have time for you to investigate one of these further this week.

Which one would you investigate first?

Tell me:

- what caught your attention;

- what you would investigate next;

- what concerns you;

- and, importantly, what you do not yet know.

There isn't a hidden “correct” answer. I want to see how you think.

Maximum 250 words.





One final thing

AI use is welcome. I use AI extensively in my own business.

However, anything you submit needs to reflect your own judgment and actual experience. Shortlisted candidates will discuss their answers with me live, without advance preparation.



Please finish your application with:

Opportunity first. Evidence second. Relationship always.



If that sentence is missing, I will assume you haven't read the complete advertisement.



Elle Nagy

title: Surplus Sales Representative
description:
SURPLUS SALES REPRESENTATIVE

Growing tax and foreclosure surplus recovery company is seeking motivated, professional, and persuasive Sales Representatives to join our team.

We help former property owners pursue surplus funds that may remain after a tax and foreclosure sale.

Prior surplus funds experience is NOT required. We will train the right person.

We are looking for English speaking individuals who are confident speaking with people, comfortable on the telephone, persistent without being overly aggressive, and capable of building trust with potential clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Our research team identifies potential surplus opportunities and provides leads for outreach.

Your primary responsibility is to turn qualified leads into signed clients.

You will:

• Contact prospective clients by telephone and other approved methods

• Explain who we are and the surplus recovery service we provide

• Explain the recovery process in a clear and professional manner

• Answer questions about our company’s services

• Build trust and rapport with prospective clients

• Follow up consistently with interested prospects

• Address reasonable concerns and objections

• Obtain the information and documents required for the client package

• Make sure agreements, authorizations, and other required documents are properly completed

• Follow up on incomplete client packages

• Maintain accurate notes regarding every prospect and follow-up

• Keep leads organized and properly tracked

• Turn completed client packages over to our recovery team

Your job is to get the client successfully signed and the client package completed.

Once the completed package is turned over, our paralegal/recovery team takes over the file and works the recovery process.

THIS IS NOT ORDINARY COLD CALLING

Many former homeowners do not know that surplus funds may exist after their tax and foreclosure.

Others may have already received letters or calls from multiple recovery companies and may initially be skeptical.

For that reason, we need representatives who know how to communicate credibility, establish trust, listen, follow up, and close.

We do not want high-pressure or misleading sales tactics.

We want representatives who can be persistent while treating people professionally and respectfully. Many of the people we contact have gone through a difficult financial situation involving the loss of their property.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Have previous sales, telephone sales, collections, customer acquisition, or closing experience

• Are comfortable making outbound calls

• Are confident speaking with strangers

• Know how to build rapport quickly

• Are persuasive without being dishonest or overly aggressive

• Are comfortable handling objections

• Understand the importance of follow-up

• Are self-motivated and results-oriented

• Can work independently

• Are organized and dependable

• Are coachable and willing to learn

• Communicate professionally

• Are comfortable working toward measurable sales goals

Previous tax and foreclosure or surplus recovery experience is a plus, but it is NOT required.

We can teach you the surplus business.

You bring the ability to communicate, follow up, and close.



COMPENSATION – COMMISSION BASED (Hourly wage contingent on experience)

This is a commission-based position with an hourly wage contingent on experience.

The Sales Representative will earn a commission equal to 5% of the fee actually collected by the Company on each successfully recovered claim originating from a client secured by the Sales Representative.

HOW IT WORKS

Your responsibility is to work the leads provided to you and secure the client by obtaining a properly completed and signed client package.

Once the client package is completed and accepted, the file is transferred to our paralegal/recovery team, which handles the recovery process.

When the claim is successfully recovered and the Company receives its recovery fee, you earn:

5% OF THE COMPANY’S COLLECTED FEE

For example:

If the Company collects a $10,000 recovery fee on a client you secured:

Your commission = $500

If the Company collects a $20,000 recovery fee:

Your commission = $1,000

If the Company collects a $30,000 recovery fee:

Your commission = $1,500

There is no fixed dollar amount per client because surplus recoveries and the Company’s resulting fees vary from claim to claim.

The objective is simple:

The more qualified clients you successfully secure—and the greater the resulting recoveries—the greater your earning potential.

Commission is earned on qualifying claims after the Company has actually received the applicable recovery fee.

Specific commission eligibility, payment timing, and other compensation terms will be provided in the Sales Representative Agreement.

A NEW COMPANY WITH ROOM TO GROW

We are a new and growing company, and we are intentionally looking for people who want the opportunity to grow with the company as the company grows.

We are building our core team now.

People who demonstrate strong performance, professionalism, reliability, and leadership ability may have opportunities for greater responsibility as our sales operation expands.

We are not simply looking for someone who wants to make a few calls.

We are looking for people who want to produce, grow, and become an important part of what we’re building.

IMPORTANT

This is a surplus recovery company and not a law firm.

Sales Representatives do not provide legal advice, interpret legal rights, represent clients in court, or make guarantees regarding whether or when funds will be recovered.

Your responsibility is client acquisition and completion of the client package.

TO APPLY

Please respond with:

1. Your name and best telephone number

2. A brief description of your sales experience

3. Your experience with outbound telephone sales or lead follow-up

4. What types of products or services you have sold

5. Your experience working on commission or performance-based compensation

6. Whether you are comfortable with the 5% commission structure described above

7. Your current availability

8. Why you believe you would be successful contacting tax and foreclosure surplus prospects

9. A brief example of how you would respond to a prospect who says: “I’ve already had several companies contact me. Why should I work with you?”

Please do not send a generic response.

We are looking for closers—but we are also looking for professionalism, integrity, persistence, and people who want to grow with the company.

Training Provided • Leads Provided • Commission Based • Growth Opportunity

title: B2B Sales VA / Sales Closer – Websites & Digital Services – Paid Trial → Ongoing
description:
About the role

Yoad Halm Digital is a New Zealand-based digital business helping small service businesses with practical websites, enquiry systems and related digital/admin solutions.

I’m looking for a salesperson who can actually manage a sales conversation, not primarily a lead researcher.

We can provide researched and approved prospects. Your role is to take those opportunities and work them through the sales process.



What you may handle

- personalised first contact

- opening and managing sales conversations

- discovery and understanding what the business actually needs

- qualification

- follow-up

- objection handling

- recommending an appropriate approved service

- progressing suitable prospects toward payment

- ideally closing the sale

For custom projects, you can gather the client’s requirements and bring them back to me. I will prepare the approved scope, quote/proposal and payment link, and you can then take that back to the prospect and continue working toward the close.

You are not limited to low-ticket work. If you uncover a genuine US$1,000+ website or custom-system opportunity, that is welcome.



Current Yoad Halm Digital starting points

- Template Setup Help: from US$149

- Starter Website: from US$299

- Website + Enquiry System: from US$499

- Business Website & Admin Setup: from US$997

- Custom Systems: quoted individually

You will not be expected or authorised to invent pricing, discounts, guarantees, delivery dates or technical promises. If something needs owner approval, you bring it back to me.



Initial paid trial

The first engagement is a 14-day paid sales calibration using 5 researched and owner-approved prospects.

Fixed trial payment: US$80

In addition:

10% of qualifying collected service revenue where you materially develop and qualify the opportunity and I materially take over the close.

15% of qualifying collected service revenue where you materially carry the sales conversation through to the agreed paid sale.

Commission is calculated on collected YHD service revenue and excludes taxes, refunds/chargebacks, domains, third-party software/licences, advertising spend and other pass-through costs.

Client payments are made directly to Yoad Halm Digital.

This is not a commission-only trial. The US$80 fixed trial payment applies to the agreed five-prospect calibration.

If the trial works well, there may be ongoing part-time sales work, additional approved prospect batches and a longer-term compensation arrangement.



What I’m looking for

I care much more about demonstrated sales ability than impressive job titles.

You should be comfortable with:

- B2B outbound sales

- written outreach

- discovery and qualification

- follow-up discipline

- objection handling

- asking for the sale

- working honestly without exaggerating claims

- keeping clear sales notes and next actions

Experience selling websites, digital services, marketing, SaaS, professional services or other B2B services is useful but not essential if your sales fundamentals are strong.

Strong spoken and written English is important.

You should be able to overlap for at least some New Zealand business hours. A useful window is approximately 1pm–5pm New Zealand time, which is generally morning in the Philippines.



This is not mass outreach

We do not want spam, purchased lists or hundreds of generic messages.

Prospects will be researched and approved. Outreach should be personalised and relevant to the individual business.



How to apply

Please answer every question below. Generic applications that do not answer them will not be shortlisted.

Start your application with:

SALES FIRST

Thanks,

Yoad

Yoad Halm Digital





Application questions

1. Tell me about one B2B sale you personally helped close. What was being sold, roughly what was the deal value, what did you personally do, and what was the final outcome?

2. Give me a second example, if you have one, where you handled the prospect beyond simply booking an appointment.

3. Which parts of the sales process have you personally handled: first contact, discovery, qualification, sales calls, follow-up, objections, proposals, negotiation, asking for payment, closing?

4. Which channels have you personally used:
, LinkedIn, phone, WhatsApp, Zoom/Meet, CRM follow-up, other?

5. How do you normally follow up with a prospect who seems interested but then stops replying?

6. Give one example of an objection you have handled successfully and how you responded.

7. Are you comfortable selling from prospects that we research and approve, rather than spending most of your time creating lead lists?

8. Are you comfortable gathering requirements for a custom project, sending them back to us for an approved quote/proposal/payment link, and then continuing the conversation yourself toward the close?

9. Are you comfortable with the initial US$80 / 5-prospect / 14-day paid trial, plus 10% or 15% performance compensation as described above?

10. If the trial succeeds, what hourly rate or monthly part-time retainer would you expect for ongoing work?

11. What hours are you normally available, and can you overlap with approximately 1pm–5pm New Zealand time when needed?

12. Please provide a 60–90 second voice recording or accessible voice-introduction link briefly describing your sales experience.

13. Short exercise: Imagine we give you a New Zealand landscaping company with 15+ years of experience and good reviews, but an old/basic website that does not present its work well. Write the first outreach message you would send. Do not invent facts or promise results.

title: YouTube Editor Virtual Assistant
description:
YouTube Growth & Podcast Guest Outreach Virtual Assistant



**Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Female Entrepreneur/Personal Brand**



I am looking for a proactive, highly organized **YouTube Growth & Guest Outreach Virtual Assistant** to help me grow and relaunch my personal brand and YouTube channel.



My brand focuses on women, entrepreneurship, creating multiple streams of income, health, personal growth, and what it looks like to **start over and build a new chapter of life at 47**.



I am also launching a new entrepreneur interview series featuring women who are willing to **share what is actually working in their businesses without gatekeeping**.



This is NOT just a basic administrative VA position.



I am looking for someone who understands content, can research strategically, spot interesting entrepreneurs and trending topics, help recruit great podcast/YouTube guests, repurpose content, and eventually help me manage the backend of a growing YouTube media brand.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Guest Research & Outreach



You will research female entrepreneurs who would make strong guests for my YouTube interview series.



Potential topics and industries include:



* Amazon Influencer Program

* TikTok Shop

* UGC/content creation

* Affiliate marketing

* Etsy

* Digital products

* YouTube

* AI businesses

* Online coaching

* Freelancing

* Virtual assistants

* Social media agencies

* Wellness businesses

* Beauty businesses

* Local service businesses

* Real estate

* E-commerce

* Multiple income streams

* Women who started successful businesses after 40, 50 or 60



You will research potential guests on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, podcasts and other appropriate platforms.



You will maintain a detailed guest database including contact information, business model, social platforms, audience size, why they would be a good guest, outreach status, follow-up dates and booking status.



You will also send personalized outreach using templates I provide and follow up professionally with potential guests.



**I do NOT want mass spam outreach. Quality and personalization matter.**



- YouTube Research & Growth



You will help research:



* Trending topics in female entrepreneurship

* Questions women are currently asking about making money

* YouTube competitors and similar channels

* High-performing video topics

* Potential titles and hooks

* Thumbnail concepts

* Search keywords

* Emerging side hustles and income opportunities

* Q4 business and income opportunities

* Topics that are gaining traction across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram



I want someone who can look at content and ask:



**“Why did this video perform well, and how can we create our own original angle around this topic?”**



- Content Repurposing



Each long-form YouTube episode should become multiple pieces of short-form content.



You will help identify strong moments from interviews and solo episodes that can become:



* YouTube Shorts

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok videos

*
 Reels

* Quote graphics

* Social media posts

* Promotional clips



You should be able to identify strong hooks, surprising statements, educational moments and highly shareable sections of an interview.



Video editing experience with **CapCut or similar software is strongly preferred.**



- YouTube Publishing & Optimization



Depending on your experience, responsibilities may include:



* Uploading YouTube videos

* Creating optimized descriptions

* Adding chapters/timestamps

* Adding appropriate tags/keywords

* Scheduling videos

* Uploading thumbnails

* Creating playlists

* Adding end screens/cards when appropriate

* Connecting Shorts to relevant long-form videos

* Scheduling Community posts

* Organizing the content calendar

* Monitoring comments and identifying audience questions



- Analytics



Each week, I want a simple report showing what is working.



This may include:



* Views

* Impressions

* Click-through rate

* Average view duration

* Audience retention

* Subscribers gained

* Top-performing videos

* Top-performing Shorts

* Traffic sources

* Returning viewers

* Topics that appear to be resonating

* Recommendations for what we should test next



I don't just want numbers copied from YouTube Studio.



I want someone who is willing to learn how to interpret the numbers and help identify patterns.



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You may be a good fit if you are:



* Extremely organized

* Resourceful

* Comfortable doing online research

 communication skills
