title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) - No Night Shift Required
description:
Two small US companies are building their books from scratch, and I'm looking for one person to own them. I'm the outside finance lead for both companies. You'll work with me regularly. Flexible on working hours (e.g. no night shift for the long term).



ABOUT THE WORK

There are two companies.

TTH is a US holding company. It makes investments in other companies and collects income from them. That income arrives as USDC, a stablecoin worth $1.00 US. It gets converted to dollars and moved into a US bank account.



LL is a game development studio. It creates games and doesn't publish them itself. LL isn't formed yet. When it is, you'll set up its books from day one, the same way you will for TTH.



Neither company has any existing bookkeeping. There's no cleanup, no previous bookkeeper's mess to inherit, no bad chart of accounts to work around. You start with an empty QuickBooks Online file and build it properly the first time.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Accounts payable and accounts receivable

• Monthly reconciliation of a US bank account (Mercury) and a Coinbase Business account

• The monthly close, and the close checklist itself, which you'll write

• Tracking income from each investment

• Routine tax forms. Collecting W-9s and W-8s, preparing 1099s, supporting state and annual report filings

• The year-end package that goes to our US CPA

• Standing up LL's books once that entity exists



WHAT YOU WON'T OWN

• Annual income tax returns. Our US CPA prepares and files those. You build the package they work from, and you handle routine forms throughout the year, but the return itself isn't yours.

• Financial modeling, forecasting, budgets

• Investor or board reporting

Those stay with me and our outside advisors. Your job is books that are accurate, current, and closed on time.



ACCOUNTING STANDARD

Accrual basis, structured to follow GAAP.

We don't produce audited financials, so you won't draft footnotes or build audit workpapers. The bar is simpler than that. An outside CPA should be able to open these books and prepare a return without doing a cleanup project first.



SCHEDULE

Work your own hours, on Philippine time. No fixed shift, no graveyard.

Two exceptions, and I'd rather be straight about them now than surprise you later.

• During onboarding, roughly the first 30 to 60 days, I'll need some real-time overlap with US Pacific hours for setup calls. We'll agree on times that actually work for you.

• During monthly close, I need you reachable for a call in a window we both agree to.

Once we're in a rhythm, this role is fully async. I care about deadlines, not about when you're at your desk.



ON AI

What's required is an open mind and a willingness to learn.

We use AI to automate the repetitive parts of this work and to error-check output before it goes out. I'll teach you how. You don't need any experience with it. You need to be interested in picking it up.

If you're already doing this, say so, because it's a real plus. But it isn't a requirement. I'd rather hire a careful bookkeeper who's curious about AI than someone who lists ten tools and doesn't check their own work.



REQUIREMENTS

• 4+ years of bookkeeping for US-based clients

• Fluent in QuickBooks Online

• You've personally owned a full monthly close, start to finish. Not just entered data into someone else's process.

• Accrual-basis experience

• Clear written English

• Reliable internet, and a backup plan for power or connection outages

• Comfortable working independently, and willing to write down what you d
 and why



NICE TO HAVE

None of these are required. They're genuine pluses.

• Crypto or stablecoin transactions. Conceptual understanding is plenty.

• You already use AI in your bookkeeping work

• Multi-entity bookkeeping

• 1099 preparation

• Mercury or Coinbase Business

• Accounting degree or CPA (Philippines)



TERMS

• Part-time, around 20 hours per week. That's a good-faith estimate, not a cap and not a minimum. Close weeks run heavier, other weeks lighter.

• $900 USD per month, flat rate. Paid monthly via Wise.

• Independent contractor role. You'll sign a contractor agreement and NDA before starting.

• Long-term role. Both companies are early. As they grow, especially once LL is running, I expect this to become full-time. We'll revisit the rate in writing when LL's books come online, or any time the workload consistently runs above the estimate.



A NOTE ON ACCESS

You'll have view-only access to our accounts. You won't move money, initiate payments, or hold wallet keys. That isn't about trust. It's how controls should be built at any company, and it protects you as much as it protects us.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word LEDGER so I know you read this far.

Then answer two questions. Short answers are fine, a few sentences each. I read all of them.

1. Walk me through your monthly close checklist. What do you do, in what order, and how do you know a month is actually closed?

2. Tell me about a time you caught an error in your own work before anyone else did. How did you find it?

Please skip the generic cover letter. Two honest paragraphs beat a page of adjectives.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test task. It's a sample transaction file to categorize, 60 to 90 minutes, paid $25 whether or not you get the job.

title: Sales Representative
description:
# The Everyday Cleaners, Seattle, WA

## EARN A BASE RATE + $10 FOR EVERY CLEAN YOU BOOK



**Book 30 cleans in a month? That’s $300 in commission. Book 50? That’s $500—on top of your hourly pay.**



We’re hiring a **Sales Representative & Outreach Specialist** who already knows how to sell cleaning services and wants the opportunity to earn more as they produce results.



If you have at least **one year of sales experience with a cleaning company**, love getting on the phone, and know how to turn an inquiry into a booked clean, keep reading.



## So Who Are We?



We’re The Everyday Cleaners, a growing residential cleaning company based in Seattle, Washington.



We connect customers with reliable cleaners and manage the experience from the first inquiry through the completed job. We’re a small team, which means the person in this role will have a direct impact on our bookings and growth.



You’ll work closely with me, John, and with Beth, our operations manager. We want someone who brings experience to the table, takes ownership of their leads, and can help us get better at sales as we grow.



## Who Are We Looking For?



We’re looking for someone who has **sold cleaning services before**. You understand how to ask about a home, explain the value of a clean, handle pricing questions, follow up, and confidently ask for the booking.



You won’t be waiting around for leads all day. You’ll answer inbound inquiries *and* create new opportunities by reaching out to real estate agents and potential customers.



You should enjoy the work of sales: having conversations, staying on top of follow-ups, tracking your numbers, and finding ways to improve your results.



## Why Should You Work Here?



- **Earn a steady hourly base plus commission:** Every closed, booked clean adds $10 to your pay.

- **See your work make a difference:** Your calls and follow-ups directly contribute to our growth.

- **Bring your ideas:** You’ll have a voice in improving our scripts and sales process.

- **Room to grow:** There’s an opportunity to move into a full-time role within the next couple of months, based on your progress, results, and the needs of the business.



## Schedule & Compensation



**Wednesday–Saturday:** 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. Pacific Time  

**Sunday:** 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Pacific Time  

**Monday–Tuesday:** Off



- **26 hours per week at $5 USD/hour — $130 USD/week base pay**

- **$10 commission for every closed, booked clean**

- **30 booked cleans in a month = $300 in commission**

- **50 booked cleans in a month = $500 in commission**



Commission depends on the number of cleans you close and book. The examples above are opportunities, not guaranteed earnings.



## Responsibilities



- Answer inbound sales calls and respond quickly to new inquiries.

- Gather the details needed to provide accurate, profitable cleaning quotes.

- Follow up with leads, answer questions, and close bookings.

- Prospect through cold calls,
, LinkedIn, and
, including outreach to real estate agents.

- Pass complete booking details to Beth for scheduling and coordination.

- Update the KPI tracker daily with every lead, call, quote, follow-up, and booking.

- Send a daily summary of activity, results, and outstanding follow-ups.

- Share ideas to improve sales scripts, outreach, and conversion rates.



## Ideal Requirements



- **At least one year of sales experience with a cleaning company; two or more years preferred**

- Experience personally closing cleaning bookings over the phone

- Strong spoken and written English

- Confidence with cold calls, follow-ups, and handling pricing objections

- The ability to gather job details and prepare accurate quotes

- Strong organization and consistent CRM updates

- A reliable laptop or PC, stable internet, and a quiet place to take calls



Experience with BookingKoala, Quo, Slack, or similar tools is a plus.



## How to Apply



Send your **updated resume** and a **short message answering these three questions**:



1. How long have you worked in cleaning company sales, and approximately how many bookings did you close in a typical month?

2. A customer received a cleaning quote yesterday but hasn’t responded. What follow-up message would you send?

3. Can you work the full Wednesday–Sunday schedule in Pacific Time?



**Be specific. We want to hear about your actual sales experience and see how you communicate. Applications without a resume and answers to all three questions will not be considered.**



Looking forward to connecting!



Best,

title: Full-Time Video Editor Work Arrangement: Remote Schedule: Full-Time / Long-Term Experience
description:
FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR — GAMING, DJ & IRL CONTENT CREATOR



Position: Full-Time Video Editor Work Arrangement: Remote Schedule: Full-Time / Long-Term Experience: Experienced video editor with a strong portfolio required



ABOUT THE CREATOR



I am a full-time content creator building the TermedCash brand across YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms.



My primary job is to create the content. I will be livestreaming, gaming, DJing, filming with professional cameras, exploring the city, doing food reviews, and creating other personality-driven content.



I am looking for a long-term video editor who can take my raw footage/VODs and turn them into high-quality, entertaining content that people actually want to watch.



This is NOT a simple "cut the video and add captions" position.



I need someone who understands storytelling, pacing, audience retention, humor, entertainment, and short-form content.

You should be able to watch a long VOD and independently recognize:



* What is boring and should be removed

* What is entertaining

* What has viral/short-form potential

* What could become a strong YouTube video

* Where the pacing needs to change

* Where an edit, zoom, sound effect, graphic, B-roll, or other technique would improve the viewer experience



I am looking for someone who can become a creative partner, not someone who needs to be told exactly where every cut should go.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



For each livestream VOD I provide, you will create:



1. ONE CLEANED/EDITED VOD

The purpose of this video is to preserve the overall livestream while making it substantially more watchable.



You will:



* Remove unnecessary dead air

* Remove technical problems

* Remove excessively long pauses

* Remove waiting/loading screens when appropriate

* Remove repetitive or irrelevant sections

* Clean up awkward transitions

* Maintain important conversations and moments

* Preserve the natural personality and flow of the stream

* Make the video feel intentional rather than like an untouched recording



Important: This is NOT supposed to be edited as aggressively as the highlight video.



The viewer should still feel like they are watching the complete stream, just without unnecessary downtime and distractions.



2. ONE HIGH-QUALITY LONG-FORM HIGHLIGHT VIDEO



From the same VOD, you will create one standalone YouTube video built around the strongest content from the stream.



This is the most heavily edited piece.



You are expected to identify the story or central entertainment value of the VOD and build the video around it.



The highlight should:



* Have a strong opening

* Get to the interesting material quickly

* Maintain viewer interest throughout

* Remove unnecessary gameplay/conversation

* Have strong pacing

* Use cuts intentionally

* Use zooms/crops when appropriate

* Use sound effects when appropriate

* Use music when appropriate

* Use B-roll when appropriate

* Use visual effects sparingly and intentionally

* Emphasize funny, exciting, surprising, intense, or emotional moments

* Have smooth transitions

* Have clean audio

* Have appropriate color correction

* Feel like a professionally produced YouTube video



STORYTELLING IS CRITICAL



Do not simply take the best 20–30 minutes of a VOD and put them together.



The footage should be structured into a coherent and entertaining video.



If the VOD contains a story, challenge, goal, progression, conflict, funny situation, unexpected event, or payoff, the edit should make that story easy for the viewer to follow.



The viewer should always have a reason to continue watching.



3. SIX SHORT-FORM VIDEOS



From each VOD, you will identify and create 6 engaging short-form videos.



These will be formatted for:



* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

* Instagram Reels



Required format:



9:16 vertical



Each short should be designed as its own piece of content — NOT simply a random section cut from the livestream.



You are responsible for finding the six strongest moments.



Potential moments include:



* Funny reactions

* Unexpected events

* Arguments/debates

* Incredible gameplay

* Fails

* Wins

* Surprising moments

* Interesting conversations

* Emotional moments

* Unusual situations

* Strong opinions

* Stories

* Memorable interactions

* Anything else that has strong entertainment value



Each short should:



* Hook the viewer quickly

* Get to the point

* Have strong pacing

* Remove unnecessary setup

* Keep the viewer's attention

* Use captions/subtitles where appropriate

* Use appropriate zooms/crops

* Use visual changes when appropriate

* Have clean audio

* Be properly framed for mobile viewing

* End naturally

* Be entertaining even to someone who has never watched my stream



DO NOT MAKE SIX RANDOM CLIPS.



I am specifically looking for someone who can recognize content potential.



If there are 20 potentially usable moments in a VOD, you should be able to determine which six have the greatest potential as short-form content.



THE CONTENT PIPELINE



For every VOD assigned to you, the expected output is:



1 VOD EDIT + 1 LONG-FORM HIGHLIGHT + 6 SHORT-FORM VIDEOS



TOTAL: 8 finished pieces of content per VOD



The exact length of each piece will depend on the footage and the story.



I care more about quality and entertainment value than hitting an arbitrary runtime.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



I am NOT looking for an editor who simply knows Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or another editing program.



Software knowledge is important, but editing judgment is more important.



I want someone who understands:



STORYTELLING



You know how to turn raw footage into a story.



PACING



You understand when a video needs to move faster and when a moment needs room to breathe.



RETENTION



You understand why viewers leave a video and how editing can keep them watching.



COMEDIC TIMING



You understand how cuts, pauses, zooms, sound effects, and timing can make a funny moment significantly better.



SHORT-FORM CONTENT



You understand how TikTok, Shorts, and Reels differ from traditional long-form YouTube videos.



VISUAL STORYTELLING



You know how to use B-roll, screenshots, graphics, gameplay, crops, zooms, and other visual elements to keep the viewer engaged.



AUDIO



You can produce clean, balanced audio and understand how music, sound effects, dialogue, and game audio should work together.



EDITORIAL JUDGMENT



You can make good decisions without needing me to tell you every single cut.



EDITING STYLE



I do NOT want every video overloaded with:



* Random zooms

* Excessive memes

* Constant sound effects

* Unnecessary transitions

* Flashing graphics

* Overused subtitles

* Effects simply for the sake of effects



The editing should be intentional.



The style should match the moment.



If something is hilarious, make it funnier.



If something is intense, make it feel intense.



If something is emotional, don't ruin it with unnecessary effects.



If something is boring, cut it.



If something is important to the story, let it breathe.



The goal is entertainment, not editing for the sake of editing.



INDEPENDENCE & CREATIVE JUDGMENT



This is extremely important.



I will provide the raw VOD/footage and overall direction.



I do NOT want to spend hours explaining:



"Cut at 01:24:37, zoom in at 01:24:41, add this sound effect at 01:24:44..."



I am hiring an editor because I want you to make those decisions.



You should be comfortable receiving a VOD and saying:

"This is the story."

"This section is unnecessary."

"This moment would make a great Short."

"This part needs to be rearranged."

"The opening is too slow."

"This needs more context."

That kind of creative thinking is highly valued.



SOFTWARE



You may use whatever professional editing software you are most comfortable with, including:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Other professional editing software



The software itself is not the d
 factor.



Your finished work is.



ORGANIZATION



You must maintain an organized workflow.



Projects should include:



* Clearly organized project files

* Clearly named sequences

* Properly organized assets

* Properly organized audio

* Properly organized graphics

* Logical folder structures

* Easily editable project files



All finished videos should be delivered in the required formats and resolutions.



Source/project files must be retained and available for future revisions when requested.



COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Responsive

* Reliable

* Organized

* Able to follow deadlines

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Comfortable making revisions

* Able to communicate when something is unclear

* Proactive when you identify a better creative solution



I am looking for a long-term working relationship, not someone who wants to complete a few projects and disappear.



REQUIREMENTS

REQUIRED:



* Proven professional video editing experience

* Strong portfolio

* Experience editing long-form YouTube content

* Experience editing short-form vertical content

* Strong understanding of pacing and storytelling

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent understanding of English

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to meet deadlines consistently

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to receive and implement feedback



STRONGLY PREFERRED:



* Gaming content experience

* Twitch/YouTube livestream editing experience

* Experience creating viral/engaging Shorts

* Experience with personality-driven creators

* Experience with DJ/music content

* Experience with IRL/vlog content

* Motion graphics experience

* Audio editing experience

* Color correction/grading experience

* Thumbnail/design knowledge



APPLICATION PROCESS



Please DO NOT send a generic application saying:



"I am interested. I have 5 years of experience."



I want to see your actual work.



Please provide:



1. Portfolio

Send your best video-editing work.

Do NOT send 30 mediocre examples.

Send your 3–5 strongest examples.



2. Long-form example

Send your best example of a YouTube video where you were responsible for storytelling/pacing.



3. Short-form examples

Send your 3 best Shorts/TikToks/Reels.

I want to see what you can do with short-form content.



4. Gaming/livestream example

If you have edited Twitch/YouTube VODs before, provide an example.

If you have never edited livestream content, clearly state that.



5. Tell me what editing software you use



6. Tell me your hourly rate or expected monthly salary



7. Tell me your typical turnaround time

For example:

* Full VOD edit: ___ days

* Long-form highlight: ___ days

* Short-form clips: ___ days



8. Tell me your availability

Include:

* Hours available per day

* Days available per week

* Time zone

* Whether you currently work with other clients



PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid editing test using actual footage from my content.



The purpose of the test is NOT to see whether you can follow instructions.



It is to see whether you can make good creative decisions.



The test may include:



* A section of a livestream VOD

* A request to identify a strong highlight

* One short-form clip

* Basic cleanup/editing



I will evaluate:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Creativity

* Editing judgment

* Audio

* Captions

* Visual quality

* Hook

* Retention potential

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow the requested style

* Ability to meet the deadline



The paid test will be compensated.



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This position is NOT for someone looking for simple repetitive editing work.



It is also NOT for someone who believes that adding lots of effects automatically makes a video better.



I am building a serious content brand and want the quality of the content to improve over time.



I want an editor who is:



Creative. Reliable. Detail-oriented. Entertainment-focused. Independent. Open to feedback. Interested in growing with the brand.



If that sounds like you, I would love to see your work.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



"I UNDERSTAND THE 8-PIECE CONTENT PIPELINE."



Then answer the following:



1. How many years have you been editing professionally?

2. What software do you use?

3. What is your strongest type of editing?

4. Have you edited livestream VODs before? Explain.

5. Have you created Shorts/TikToks/Reels from long-form footage before?

6. Provide your 3–5 best examples.

7. What is your hourly rate/monthly salary expectation?

8. What is your availability?

9. What is your typical turnaround time?

10. What do you believe makes a short-form video entertaining?

11. What do you believe makes viewers continue watching a long-form YouTube video?

12. Watch this sample footage: [INSERT SAMPLE FOOTAGE LINK]

Identify one moment you would turn into a Short and explain why.

13. Tell me one thing you would improve about your favorite piece in your portfolio.



The last two questions are important because I want to see how you think, not just what software you know.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.

This is a GHL builder - someone who understands CRM and automation logic and can take a goal (sometimes a detailed brief, sometimes just an outcome) and make the technical pieces work. You'll often need to think one step ahead technically (e.g., building a tag structure that anticipates what's needed later) without making strategy calls.



Role details

- Full-time, 8 hours/day (7am - 4pm PH time)

- Remote



What You'll Handle

- Automation & Workflows - build, test, and troubleshoot workflows from a brief or a goal (triggers, conditions, branching, tags, delays, pipeline actions)

/Google ad funnel setup and approvals (technical setup)

About the role

We're a fast-growing telehealth company, and we're looking for a QA / Test Engineer to own product quality end to end. You'll test features before they ship, own our release process, and keep our bug backlog under control so the team can move quickly without compromising quality.



This is a hands-on role that goes beyond manual testing. You'll own the path from "code complete" to "safely released" across our web and mobile products.



What you'll do

• Own the release process: test staging builds, run the final quality gate before ship, and help us move toward faster, more frequent releases.

• Perform mobile device testing on Android, including reproducing and verifying device-specific issues.

• Triage, track, and manage bugs, driving them to closure and keeping the backlog under control.

• Build and maintain automated tests to expand coverage and speed up regression testing.



What we're looking for

• Solid QA / software testing experience, ideally in a fast-moving product environment.

• Experience writing and improving test automation and test infrastructure, including using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to build and improve automation.

• Hands-on Android device testing experience.

• Comfortable testing web applications end to end.

• Experience working across dev, staging, and production environments and with release processes.

• Strong bug tracking, test case management, and triage skills.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to distinguish release-blocking issues from minor ones.

• Able to drive quality independently while partnering closely with engineering and product.



Nice to have

• Healthcare or telehealth experience.

• Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM).

• Experience helping a team move toward a continuous release cycle.

title: Onboarding Specialist (CSR)
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:





Ansible Health is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Onboarding Specialist / Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our innovative team. As a key member of our patient-centric approach to healthcare delivery, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new patients and providing exceptional customer service.



What is AnsibleHealth?

AnsibleHealth unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Onboarding Specialist / CSR to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering superior customer service, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.



Responsibilities

- Customize initial discussions based on patient needs, ensuring they understand how the program can address their specific health conditions, providing personalized benefits rather than general services.

- Manage inquiries through multiple communication channels (phone, email, etc.), including voi
 inbox management and message routing, providing prompt and accurate responses.

- Process and manage referrals, working towards efficient conversion within a 7-10 day timeframe while managing multiple referral loop processes for a large patient panel.

- Perform comprehensive data entry including clinical survey scores/results, diagnostic tests, remote physiologic monitoring (RPM), and remote therapeutic monitoring (RTM) data streams.

- Schedule and coordinate patient appointments while maintaining communication with patients regarding their care schedule.

- Manage and process inbound and outbound medical records, ensuring proper documentation and organization.

- Maintain accurate EMR records by updating care notes, face sheets, and ensuring the integrity of patient information.

- Attend clinical meetings, take detailed notes, and follow up on action items and project timelines.

- Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of physicians, engineers, designers, and care team members to continuously improve patient care delivery.

- Resolve patient issues and complaints, identifying problems and finding appropriate solutions to ensure patient satisfaction while maintaining professional communication throughout the process.

- Achieve daily call quotas of 75-100 interactions.

- Adhere to established performance metrics to qualify for incentive plans tied to performance.





The ideal candidate for this role at Ansible Health is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. They should also possess exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, coupled with meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational abilities. They should be adept at managing multiple priorities, from patient onboarding to referral management.





Required Qualifications and Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Nursing, Physical Therapy, or other healthcare-related fields.

- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in customer service, preferably in a healthcare and/or sales environment.

- Sales experience or demonstrated ability to effectively communicate value propositions.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex medical concepts in easily understandable terms.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, EMR software, and standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).

- Typing speed of at least 60 words per minute.

- Reliable internet connection (at least 30 Mbps) and a quiet home environment for work.

- Ability to work in US time zones (EST)

title: Onboarding Specialist / CSR
description:

Ansible Health is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Onboarding Specialist / Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our innovative team. As a key member of our patient-centric approach to healthcare delivery, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new patients and providing exceptional customer service.



What is AnsibleHealth?

AnsibleHealth unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Onboarding Specialist / CSR to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering superior customer service, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.



Responsibilities

- Customize initial discussions based on patient needs, ensuring they understand how the program can address their specific health conditions, providing personalized benefits rather than general services.

- Manage inquiries through multiple communication channels (phone, email, etc.), including voi
 inbox management and message routing, providing prompt and accurate responses.

- Process and manage referrals, working towards efficient conversion within a 7-10 day timeframe while managing multiple referral loop processes for a large patient panel.

- Perform comprehensive data entry including clinical survey scores/results, diagnostic tests, remote physiologic monitoring (RPM), and remote therapeutic monitoring (RTM) data streams.

- Schedule and coordinate patient appointments while maintaining communication with patients regarding their care schedule.

- Manage and process inbound and outbound medical records, ensuring proper documentation and organization.

- Maintain accurate EMR records by updating care notes, face sheets, and ensuring the integrity of patient information.

- Attend clinical meetings, take detailed notes, and follow up on action items and project timelines.

- Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of physicians, engineers, designers, and care team members to continuously improve patient care delivery.

- Resolve patient issues and complaints, identifying problems and finding appropriate solutions to ensure patient satisfaction while maintaining professional communication throughout the process.

- Achieve daily call quotas of 75-100 interactions.

- Adhere to established performance metrics to qualify for incentive plans tied to performance.





The ideal candidate for this role at Ansible Health is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. They should also possess exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, coupled with meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational abilities. They should be adept at managing multiple priorities, from patient onboarding to referral management.





Required Qualifications and Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Nursing, Physical Therapy, or other healthcare-related fields.

- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in customer service, preferably in a healthcare and/or sales environment.

- Sales experience or demonstrated ability to effectively communicate value propositions.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex medical concepts in easily understandable terms.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, EMR software, and standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).

- Typing speed of at least 60 words per minute.

- Reliable internet connection (at least 30 Mbps) and a quiet home environment for work.

- Ability to work in US time zones (EST)



Nice to have

- Experience in the healthcare industry or with medical terminology.

- Proven track record in sales.

- Familiarity with remote patient monitoring systems.

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and healthcare privacy practices.





Job Details

Full-time: A minimum of 40 hours a week

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work Pacific/Eastern hours)

Benefits:

- Paid Time Off

- HMO Coverage on 3rd month

- With incentives

ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a U.S.-based marketing agency looking for an experienced Google Ads and Meta Ads Specialist to help manage paid advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts.



This is not an entry-level position.



We are looking for someone who understands performance marketing and can independently analyze an account, identify problems, build campaigns, optimize performance, troubleshoot tracking, and explain what should be changed and why.



You will initially support approximately 5–6 advertising accounts across Google and Meta.



We are much more interested in measurable results and good decision-making than simply receiving weekly reports.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

• Google Tag Manager

• Meta Pixel

• Conversion tracking

• Google Search campaigns

• Performance Max

• Lead-generation campaigns

• Audience targeting

• Keyword research

Experience with Google Merchant Center and e-commerce advertising is a plus.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who actively manages accounts.

We expect you to:



• Notice problems

• Explain why performance changed

• Recommend solutions

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

title: Senior Social Media Graphic Designer & Reels Editor
description:
Type of Work: Part-Time / Long-Term  

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week  

Location: Remote

Schedule: Flexible Philippine hours with occasional availability during U.S. Eastern Time



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a U.S.-based marketing agency looking for an exceptional Social Media Graphic Designer & Reels Editor to join our team long-term.



We are looking for someone who can produce work that meets professional U.S. agency standards across multiple client brands.



This is NOT a basic Canva position.



You should be equally comfortable:



- Designing manually in Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or Figma

- Editing professional short-form videos and Reels

- Using modern AI tools to improve efficiency and creativity

- Taking AI-generated assets and manually correcting/editing them until they look natural and professional

- Working with real client photos and assets

- Creating completely custom designs when AI is not appropriate



**AI should be a tool—not a replacement for design skill.**



We need someone who understands when AI helps and when traditional manual design produces the better result.



## WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



You will produce social media creative for multiple U.S.-based client accounts, including:



- Professional static graphics

- 5–6 slide carousels

- Instagram and
 posts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok/short-form videos

- Stories

- Promotional graphics

- Ad creatives

- Motion graphics

- Branded campaign content

- Photo-based designs

- AI-assisted creative when appropriate



Our content team will provide calendars, copy, concepts, brand guidelines, client information, and creative direction.



**Your responsibility is turning those ideas into exceptional visual content.**



## QUALITY EXPECTATIONS



This is the most important part of the position.



We do NOT want:



- Generic Canva templates

- Repetitive designs

- Obvious AI-generated imagery

- Fake-looking people, products, locations, food, or environments

- Poor typography

- Crowded layouts

- Basic slideshow-style Reels

- Designs that could belong to any random business

- AI outputs submitted without manual correction

- Work that requires us to repeatedly point out basic design problems



We DO want:



- Modern, polished design

- Strong typography

- Excellent spacing and visual hierarchy

- Professional photo editing

- Realistic imagery

- Clean composition

- Strong branding

- Creative concepts

- Scroll-stopping visuals

- Professional Reels with good pacing

- Consistent quality across multiple brands

- Designs appropriate for U.S. businesses and audiences



You should be able to look at your own work critically and correct problems **before submitting it for review.**



## AI + MANUAL DESIGN REQUIREMENT



You must be comfortable with BOTH traditional design and modern AI workflows.



AI experience may include tools such as:



- Adobe Firefly

- Midjourney

- Leonardo AI

- ChatGPT

- Runway

- Kling

- Other image/video generation tools



However, you must also know how to manually:



- Remove AI errors

- Correct unrealistic textures

- Fix hands, objects, products, backgrounds, and proportions

- Retouch photos

- Composite multiple images

- Color correct

- Remove or replace objects

- Adjust lighting

- Edit backgrounds

- Match branding

- Correct typography

- Blend AI elements naturally into real photography



We should never receive an obviously AI-generated image simply because an AI tool produced it.



## REQUIRED DESIGN SKILLS



Strong experience with:



- Adobe Photoshop

- Adobe Illustrator

- Canva Pro

- Figma or similar design software

- Photo manipulation and retouching

- Typography

- Layout and composition

- Brand design

- Social media graphic design

- Carousel design

- Advertising creative



## REQUIRED VIDEO SKILLS



Strong experience with:



- Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut

- Short-form video editing

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok-style content

- Hooks and pacing

- Subtitles/captions

- Transitions

- Sound effects

- Music synchronization

- Motion graphics

- Basic color correction

- Text animation



After Effects experience is a strong advantage.



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



- Have excellent visual judgment

- Understand current U.S. social media design trends

- Be able to switch between different brand styles

- Follow detailed creative briefs and SOPs

- Pay extremely close attention to instructions

- Work quickly without sacrificing quality

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Be organized when working across multiple client brands

- Communicate clearly

- Accept feedback professionally

- Apply previous feedback so the same corrections are not repeatedly needed

- Be comfortable working independently



Agency experience is strongly preferred.



Experience creating content for U.S., Canadian, UK, or Australian brands is a major plus.



## EXPERIENCE



We prefer **3+ years of professional graphic design and/or social media creative experience**.



However, portfolio quality matters more to us than years of experience.



If your work is exceptional, we want to see it.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your portfolio.

3. Your **10 best social media graphics**.

4. At least **3 carousel examples**.

5. At least **5 Reels or short-form videos** you personally edited.

6. Examples of work you created using Photoshop/Illustrator—not only Canva templates.

7. Examples of AI-assisted creative, if available.

8. Briefly explain which AI tools you use and how you combine them with manual editing.

9. Tell us which Adobe/design/video programs you are strongest in.

10. Your expected monthly salary.

11. Your current work commitments and availability.



Please begin your application with the words **"CREATIVE QUALITY"** so we know you read the entire posting.



## PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small **paid creative test**.



The test may include:



- 1 professional static social graphic

- 1 multi-slide carousel sample

- 1 short Reel/video edit



We will evaluate:



- Design quality

- Creativity

- Typography

- Attention to detail

- Ability to follow instructions

- Manual editing ability

- AI judgment

- Reel/video quality

- Speed

- Communication



We are not looking for the cheapest applicant.



We are looking for a **high-level creative professional who can become a long-term member of our agency and consistently produce work we are proud to send to our clients.**

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop original post concepts for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant platforms

• Write strong hooks, captions, CTAs, Reel concepts, carousel concepts, and on-screen text

• Create detailed creative briefs for our designers and video editors

title: Short-Term Rental Operations, Bookkeeping & Personal Assistant
description:
Position: Long-Term

Hours: 20–40 hours per week

Compensation: $4 USD per hour

Schedule: Required availability between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST daily. Specific working hours will fall within this coverage window.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the daily operations and bookkeeping of multiple U.S.-based Airbnb and short-term rental properties. The role will also include personal, administrative, purchasing, and travel-related responsibilities.

This role is ideal for someone who can take an unstructured request, research the situation, present good options, and follow the selected solution through to completion.

We do not want someone who only reports problems or waits for step-by-step instructions. We want someone who takes ownership, follows up without being reminded, verifies that work was actually completed, and knows when an issue needs to be escalated.

This is a long-term position with the potential for additional responsibility as our real estate portfolio grows.

Bookkeeping and Financial Administration

Bookkeeping will be a major part of this position. You will help keep the finances for each property and business entity accurate and organized.

Responsibilities include:

Manage bookkeeping using Intuit QuickBooks Online.

Review and classify bank and credit-card transactions regularly.

Ensure every transaction is assigned to the correct property, business entity, account, and expense category.

Separate expenses across multiple short-term rental properties and LLCs.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit-card accounts.

Match receipts and invoices to their corresponding transactions.

Track cleaner payments, contractor invoices, property supplies, repairs, utilities, subscriptions, and other operating expenses.

Identify duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly categorized transactions.

Ask for clarification rather than guessing when the correct classification is uncertain.

Maintain organized digital copies of receipts, invoices, statements, and supporting documents.

Track reimbursements, refunds, credits, security deposits, and vendor payments.

Prepare monthly property-level income and expense summaries.

Help maintain accurate profit-and-loss reporting for each property.

Coordinate with our accountant or tax professional when information or documentation is requested.

Maintain a list of recurring payments and flag unexpected price increases or duplicate subscriptions.

Direct experience with QuickBooks Online and property-level bookkeeping is preferred.

Cleaning and Turnover Coordination

Monitor reservation and turnover calendars.

Schedule cleaners after guest checkouts.

Confirm that every turnover has an assigned cleaner.

Communicate early check-ins, late checkouts, guest counts, and special instructions to cleaners.

Confirm that cleaners arrived and completed each turnover on time.

Coordinate backup cleaners when someone becomes unavailable.

Follow up on cleaning problems until they are resolved.

Maintain cleaning checklists, schedules, invoices, and payment records.

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

Coordinate lawn mowing, pool or hot-tub service, pest control, repairs, and other recurring property services.

Contact cleaners, contractors, handymen, technicians, and local vendors by phone, text, or
.

Obtain and compare estimates when appropriate.

Schedule approved work and coordinate property access.

Follow up until the work is actually completed.

Request photos, invoices, or other proof of completion.

Maintain records of maintenance issues, costs, warranties, and vendor contact information.

Identify reliable backup vendors before emergencies occur.

Guest and Reservation Support

Monitor Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Hospitable, or related platforms as assigned.

Answer routine guest questions clearly and professionally.

Coordinate solutions for lockouts, missing supplies, cleanliness problems, amenity issues, and maintenance requests.

Escalate safety issues, refund requests, major repairs, unhappy guests, or unusual situations promptly.

Assist with reservation changes, guest reviews, and Airbnb support cases when needed.

Gather photos, messages, receipts, and other documentation for damage or reimbursement claims.

Property Administration

Track recurring services, permits, licenses, utilities, insurance, subscriptions, and renewal dates.

Monitor property supplies and coordinate approved restocking.

Keep listing information, amenities, house rules, and property guides accurate.

Organize property documents and operational records.

Create and improve SOPs and checklists for recurring tasks.

Provide a concise weekly report covering open issues, completed work, upcoming turnovers, expenses, and decisions needed.

Personal and Travel Assistance

The position will also include non-property tasks such as:

Research and compare flights based on total price, duration, stops, baggage rules, airports, and cancellation policies.

Research hotels, Airbnbs, transportation, restaurants, activities, and other travel details.

Create organized itineraries containing reservation details, addresses, confirmation numbers, travel times, and important deadlines.

Verify important details directly instead of relying only on search-result summaries or AI-generated information.

Book approved flights, accommodations, transportation, reservations, and activities.

Monitor travel plans for schedule changes, cancellations, or missing details.

Research products, services, vendors, subscriptions, and personal purchases.

Start, change, renew, or cancel subscriptions after receiving approval.

Place approved online orders and track deliveries, returns, credits, and refunds.

Make phone calls and follow up with companies on our behalf.

Organize calendars, reminders, documents, and recurring personal tasks.

Assist with basic video editing as needed, including trimming clips, adding captions and music, and formatting videos for social media. Prior video-editing experience is a plus, but is not required to be hired.

Purchasing and Financial Boundaries

You may eventually receive access to authorized accounts or controlled payment methods. Trust and discretion are essential.

Significant purchases must be approved before payment.

Never change payment, payout, banking, tax, or account-ownership information without explicit approval.

Never send money to yourself or an unapproved person or vendor.

Record purchases and save receipts immediately.

Confirm cancellation and refund policies before booking.

If instructions appear unusual or potentially fraudulent, stop and verify with us directly.

Never share passwords, financial information, guest information, or property access codes with unauthorized parties.

Required Qualifications

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience as a Virtual Assistant, bookkeeper, property-management assistant, or operations coordinator.

Previous Airbnb or short-term rental experience is strongly preferred.

Comfortable calling U.S. businesses, cleaners, contractors, and customer-support departments.

Strong online research and comparison skills.

Able to manage multiple deadlines and follow up without reminders.

Able to distinguish between an urgent issue and one that can wait.

Comfortable handling confidential personal, guest, property, and financial information.

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and preferably backup internet.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, task-management software, messaging applications, and AI tools.

AI may be used to work efficiently, but all important information must be independently verified.

Able to maintain availability during the required 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST coverage window.

Helpful Experience

Experience with any of the following is beneficial:

Intuit QuickBooks Online // Bookkeeping for multiple properties or LLCs

Airbnb, VRBO, or Booking.com experience

Hospitable, Guesty, Hostaway, or another property-management system

PriceLabs or other dynamic-pricing software

Vendor dispatch, hospitality, customer service, or property maintenance

Basic video editing using CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools (nice to have, not required).

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days:

Transactions are consistently classified under the correct property, entity, and expense category.

Accounts and receipts remain organized and ready for monthly review.

Unknown transactions are flagged promptly instead of being guessed.

Every turnover is properly assigned and confirmed.

Cleaners and vendors receive the correct information without needing to chase us.

Maintenance problems are tracked through completion.

Upcoming renewals, services, and property needs do not surprise us.

Travel research is accurate, concise, and ready for a decision.

Approved bookings and purchases are completed correctly.

You identify potential problems early and bring us recommended solutions.

We spend significantly less time following up on routine financial, operational, and personal tasks.

How to Apply

Please include:

A short introduction.

Whether you have managed bookkeeping for multiple properties, businesses, or LLCs and your experience. 

Your relevant Airbnb or short-term rental experience along with any property-management tools you have used.

Your experience coordinating cleaners, contractors, or other field-service providers.

Confirmation that you can work 20–40 hours per week and maintain the required availability between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST.

A link to a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing a scheduling, bookkeeping, or operational problem you solved.

This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

title: Viral AI Content Creator
description:
About Us



Clink is a post-drink recovery supplement brand launching on Amazon US, with a growing presence on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. The brand has a clean Nordic apothecary look (think Aesop, Le Labo, Haeckels) and a voice that is considered, human and science-credible without being clinical. We are a small team with a Philippines-based VA crew already in place, and we move fast.



The Role



We need someone who lives on short-form video and knows what makes content stop the scroll. You will plan, generate and edit AI-assisted short-form videos (AI avatars, AI voiceover, AI-generated scenes, plus product footage we supply) and turn them into a steady pipeline of 5 to 10 posts per week across TikTok, Reels and Shorts.



What You Will Do



Research trending formats, hooks, sounds and creator styles in the wellness, nightlife and lifestyle niches

Write short hooks and scripts (15 to 45 seconds) in our brand voice

Generate videos using AI tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs or similar) using our two-step still-then-animate workflow

Edit in CapCut or Premiere: captions, pacing, overlays, end cards, music

Publish and schedule content, and apply AI-generated content disclosures on every platform

Track performance, report weekly on what worked, and double down on winning formats

Coordinate with our content, engagement and creator outreach VAs



You Must Have



Proof of short-form videos you have made that got real traction (views, saves, shares)

Hands-on experience with at least two AI video or voice tools

Strong CapCut or Premiere editing skills

Good written English for hooks and captions

A feel for US TikTok culture and trends

Attention to detail and the discipline to follow brand and compliance guidelines exactly



Nice to Have



Experience with supplement, beauty or wellness brands

Understanding of FDA supplement marketing rules (structure/function claims only, no disease claims)

Basic graphic design (Canva or Photoshop)

Amazon or e-commerce brand experience



Important



This is a regulated product category. All content must follow our compliance guide (we will train you). We do not use words like "hangover cure," "detox" or medical claims, and every AI-generated video is labelled as AI-generated. If you are not comfortable working within clear rules, this is not the role for you.

title: REO & Real Estate Operations Specialist
description:
We are not looking for an average VA. We are looking for someone who eventually becomes the person everyone depends on.



Woods Hometown Realty is a growing Arizona real estate brokerage specializing in REO and residential real estate. As our REO business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced U.S. real estate professional who wants to become a long term member of our team.



We hire slowly because we are looking for the RIGHT person, not simply someone to fill a position.



This position will have significant responsibility for REO tasking and property files. Accuracy is critical. REO tasks have strict requirements and deadlines, and mistakes can have serious consequences. Close enough is not good enough when working on these files.



If you are someone who sees what needs to be done and handles it, keeps yourself organized, follows through, double checks your work, and researches an issue before asking for help, we want to meet you.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



5 or more years of experience supporting a U.S. real estate agent, team, or brokerage is required.



REO EXPERIENCE WILL PUT YOU AT THE TOP OF OUR LIST.



Candidates with hands on REO experience will be considered our top candidates. If you have worked with REO properties, bank owned properties, foreclosure or default servicing, BPOs, property preservation, REO tasking, asset management platforms, utilities, title issues, listing requirements, occupancy, CFK, or similar default related work, we absolutely want to hear from you.



We understand that every REO client and brokerage has different procedures. We can teach you our processes and our clients' requirements. What we do not have time to teach is U.S. real estate from the beginning.



STABLE WORK HISTORY IS IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who wants a long term career with our company. We strongly prefer candidates who have demonstrated stability and longevity with previous employers. If you have spent several years working for the same U.S. real estate employer, that will stand out to us.



WHAT WE NEED



Excellent spoken and written English



Professional, friendly and confident telephone skills



Strong knowledge of U.S. real estate transactions



Experience with listings, contracts, documents, deadlines and transaction coordination



Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy



Ability to follow detailed instructions and client specific requirements



Strong organization and time management



Ability to manage multiple properties, deadlines and priorities at the same time



Excellent research and problem solving skills



Ability to learn new systems and procedures quickly



Excellent follow through and accountability



Ability to recognize when something does not look right and investigate it



Confidence making outbound calls and speaking with people you do not know



Reliable computer and high speed internet



Professional and quiet home work environment



Dual monitors are strongly preferred



WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON



A significant part of this position will involve REO tasking.



REO files can involve dozens of individual tasks, deadlines, documents, vendors, utilities, title issues, property research, listing requirements and follow up items. These tasks must be completed correctly and on time.



Responsibilities may include:



REO task management and administrative support



Managing and tracking multiple REO property files



Database and CRM management



Monitoring incoming emails and taking ownership of assigned items



Researching property information, liens, judgments, permits, utilities, HOA information and other property related matters



Ordering and organizing listing kits and property documents



Tracking important dates, deadlines and client requirements



Reviewing information for accuracy and identifying missing or conflicting information



Contacting title companies, utility providers, municipalities, county offices, contractors, vendors, homeowners, buyers and sellers



Scheduling appointments and coordinating property access



Making outbound calls to clients and contacts in our database



Following up with leads and helping identify potential buyers and sellers



Assisting our team with the many moving pieces involved in REO and residential properties



ACCURACY AND ACCOUNTABILITY MATTER HERE



We do not expect anyone to know everything on their first day.



We do expect you to care enough to make sure your work is right.



When you are handling an REO task, we need someone who reads the instructions, understands what is being requested, verifies the information, completes the task correctly and follows it through to completion.



If something does not make sense, stop, research it and ask. Do not guess.



We would much rather answer an intelligent question than discover later that a task was completed incorrectly.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



When you encounter something you do not know, your first instinct should be to research it and try to understand it.



We love hearing:



"I researched this and found XYZ. Based on what I found, I think this is what we need to do. Am I understanding this correctly?"



We do not want your first response to every unfamiliar situation to be:



"I don't know how to do this. What should I do?"



You will have an experienced team supporting you and we absolutely expect questions while you are learning. However, we need someone who thinks, investigates, takes initiative, takes good notes, learns from training and wants to understand why something is being done.



We value intelligence, personality, accountability, curiosity, kindness, humor, professionalism and people who genuinely care about doing a good job.



We work hard. We move fast. We take our work seriously, but we also enjoy the people we work with.



For the right person, this is intended to be a long term career opportunity, not a temporary VA position.



HOW TO RESPOND



Please send us a brief message telling us:



1. How many years you have worked in U.S. real estate



2. Whether you have REO or default servicing experience and approximately how many years



3. The types of real estate work you have handled



4. How long you were with your most recent long term employer



5. Why this particular position caught your attention



Please include the words BLUE CACTUS somewhere in your response so we know you read the entire posting.



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete our formal application and interview process.



We know great people are hard to find.



That is why we are willing to wait for the right one.

title: B-Roll & Video Asset Specialist
description:
We’re looking for someone with **real experience working with large B-roll/video libraries** to help us organise, maintain and expand our footage library for short-form and long-form content.



This is not simply a video editing role.



A major part of the job is being able to take hundreds or thousands of video clips and create a system where an editor can quickly find exactly the right clip.



We want someone who already understands how to organise footage properly rather than someone we need to teach from scratch.



## What you'll work on



You’ll help us:



- Organise large libraries of B-roll footage

- Create clear folder structures

- Rename and categorise clips

- Separate master/original footage from edited assets

- Organise footage by things such as:

  - Emotion

  - Context

  - Location

  - Action

  - Person

  - Scene

  - Cinematic style

  - Content type

- Identify the strongest usable moments from longer footage

- Build reusable B-roll libraries for our editors

- Source additional B-roll when required

- Keep the library clean as new footage is added

- Prepare footage primarily for **9:16 vertical short-form content**

- Help editors find relevant clips quickly instead of repeatedly searching from scratch



Our content includes personal-brand videos, business content, educational videos, lifestyle footage and cinematic/storytelling content.



We are also building systems around AI and automation, so experience with structured asset libraries, metadata, tagging or AI-assisted video workflows is a big advantage.



## VERY IMPORTANT — application requirement



We want to see **how you personally organise B-roll or video footage**.





1. A **Google Drive folder** showing a real B-roll/video library you have organised, OR

2. another backend system you ahve or worked on

You can blur/remove any confidential client information.



We want to see things like:



- Folder hierarchy

- File naming

- How you categorise footage

- How you handle raw footage vs selected footage

- How you organise footage that can be reused across multiple videos

- How quickly another editor could find a specific type of shot



**Please do not create a sample folder just for this application. We want to see a system you've genuinely used before.**



## Ideal candidate



You probably have experience as a:



- B-roll editor

- Video asset manager

- Assistant video editor

- Content editor

- Media manager

- YouTube editor

- Short-form video editor



You should be highly organised and comfortable dealing with a **large volume of video files**.



Experience with Google Drive is important.



Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Descript, Gling, 
 or similar is useful, but we're particularly interested in your **footage organisation skills**.



## To apply



Start your application with the words:



**B-ROLL LIBRARY**



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years have you worked with video/B-roll?

2. Roughly how large was the biggest footage library you've managed?

3. How do you normally organise B-roll so editors can find footage quickly?

4. Do you use folders only, or do you also use naming conventions, tags, metadata or databases?

5. What editing/video tools do you use?

6. Have you worked mainly with 9:16 short-form, YouTube long-form, or both?

7. Send your **Google Drive example or Loom walkthrough** showing how you organise footage.

8. Send 2–3 examples of videos where you were responsible for selecting or organising the B-roll.



Applications without the footage-library example will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys turning a messy collection of footage into a **clean, searchable, reusable content library**.



Intial part time role to begin

Wilkins & Associates is a U.S. Accounting  firm based in Spartanburg, South Carolina, providing outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, and tax services to small and mid-sized businesses across industries including professional services, real estate, restaurants, e-commerce, construction, and nonprofits.  and video call to request documents and explain results

Industry experience with restaurants, retail, and nonprofits

Dedicated, quiet, and private home workspace, since you'll handle confidential client financial data

description:
Home Services CSR / Dispatcher

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Shift: Permanent Night Shift (Mon–Fri, 40 hrs/week | 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila Time)

Total Package: PHP 52,300 / month



---

ABOUT WINSLOW PACIFIC



Based on Vancouver Island, BC, Canada, Winslow Pacific runs the back office for trade contractors. From roofers to plumbers, we answer their calls, book their appointments, and keep their schedules organized so they can stay focused on their work.



We are a registered Canadian company looking for a warm, articulate professional who can convey genuine hospitality - not read a script.



---

THE ROLE & THE MINDSET



This is not a traditional call center role, and we do not use call scripts or flowcharts.



To every caller, you are not an agent at an outsourced provider - you are sitting right in that contractor's local front office.



When a homeowner's hot water heater fails or a pump breaks, you are the calm, competent colleague on the phone who puts them at ease, checks their account in real time, and handles their issue.



Your day-to-day responsibilities:



Handle inbound calls: Light-to-moderate volume (20 to 40 calls a day). Quality, genuine connection, and accurate details matter infinitely more than handle times.



Coordinate scheduling: Book appointments, manage calendars, confirm timelines, and follow up on callbacks.



Book jobs & dispatch: Book jobs and dispatch the local crew to calls.



Quotes, invoices & follow-ups: Send out quotes and invoices, and follow up with homeowners.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



Home Services or Trades Background: You've worked with contractors or home service companies (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, well drilling, etc.). You understand how the trades work, speak confidently with homeowners about service issues, and handle calls naturally without relying on a script.



Natural North American English: You speak with natural phrasing, warmth, and confidence. You naturally avoid formal BPO habits (e.g., no "Sir/Ma'am," no "kindly," and no "please be advised").



In-House Mindset: You naturally use internal phrasing ("I'll pass this directly to Tom," "Let me pull you up in our system," "We can definitely help with that").



Meticulous Detail & Follow-Through: An unpassed detail can cost a contractor thousands of dollars. You track every detail, follow through on every promise, and stay organized.



Software: Jobber experience is highly valuable and will move your application to the top. Experience with any other contractor software (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, etc.) is a bonus.



WORK SHIFT & SCHEDULE



Hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila Time (10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Time).

Status: 40 hours/week, permanent night shift.



REQUIREMENTS



Modern, capable computer/laptop & reliable wired headset

Quiet, dedicated workspace free from background noise

High-speed internet with a backup power/internet plan

Working webcam (used for team and client check-ins)

Exclusive commitment: Full-time, dedicated focus during shift hours. No other paid work during your scheduled shift.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Monthly Package: PHP 52,300



Base Pay: PHP 42,200

Night Differential: PHP 3,570

HMO / Health Allowance: PHP 2,000

Remote Work Allowance: PHP 4,530 ($100 CAD)



Additional Perks:



Weekly Payouts: Paid every week via Wise or Payoneer.

13th Month Pay: PHP 42,200 (paid early December, pro-rated for that year if your start date is after May 31).

Canadian Holidays: 11 paid statutory holidays per year.

Paid Leave: 4% PTO accrual (approx. 10 days/year) + paid Birthday off.

Growth: Stability with a growing company that prioritizes internal promotions.

Your updated resume

title: Senior DTC Creative Strategist (Paid Social, $500k+/month adspend experience required)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



Gotya is a digital pack-ripping platform for trading card collectors. You buy a digital pack, rip it live, and the cards you hit are real cards you can ship home or sell back for cash. Real cards. Real value. Real fast.



Paid social at Gotya scales on creatives, not on budget buttons. Right now a founder still writes the scripts. That is the bottleneck you remove. You turn data, comments and the collector community into a weekly stream of angles, hooks, scripts and static concepts that our editor and creators produce. You run the testing matrix that tells us why a creative won or died, and you make sure every learning shapes the next round.



This is a senior role with a hard requirement. We only consider people who have done creative strategy for DTC brands spending $500,000 or more per month on paid social, and who can show it. If your experience sits below that level, this post is not for you. We would rather you spend your time on a role that fits.



WHAT YOU OWN



- Angles and hooks per avatar and awareness stage, mined from our community, ad comments, competitor ads and our own numbers.

- Scripts, shotlists and static concepts, written by you. Hyped about the rip, honest about the odds.

- The testing matrix: angles by avatars by formats, with a verdict per cell and the next variant ready.

- Briefing and directing our video editor and UGC creator pool, with the weekly batch delivered on schedule.

- A learning per live creative in our creatives dashboard, translated into the next round.

- The creative playbook per offer, so new makers produce at level from day one.



HOW WE MEASURE YOU



New concepts in test per week. Win rate of new creatives on our test rules. Speed from idea to live ad. CPA of your winners against the account average.



YOU HAVE



- 1+ years of creative strategy for paid social at DTC, app or e-commerce brands.

- Proven work at brands spending $500k+ per month on Meta or TikTok, where you owned the creative strategy. You can name the brands, your role and what your creatives did to CPA or ROAS.

- A clear creative process you can explain end to end, from research to live ad to learning.

- You write hooks and scripts yourself and brief editors and creators with shotlists.

- You read thumbstop, hold rate, CTR and CPA per creative and turn them into the next iteration.

- Excellent written English, full-time availability, overlap with European hours.



Bonus #1: you edit yourself (CapCut, Premiere) or use AI video tools for fast variants. 

Bonus #2: you have briefed UGC creators at scale. 

Bonus #3: you know Pokemon or the wider TCG world, or have ripped packs yourself.



WHAT WE OFFER



Fully remote with flexible hours. Market rate plus a performance bonus tied to the numbers above. You work directly with the founders, no management layers. Where this leads: Head of Creative, owning the editor, social, the UGC pool and creative strategy across every channel.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, we filter hard)



Start your application with the word CHASECARD. Applications without it are not read.

Then answer these five points, in this order:



1. EXPERIENCE. List every DTC brand where you did creative strategy at $500k+ per month in paid spend. Per brand: your role, the monthly spend range, how long you were there, the channels, and what your creatives did to CPA or ROAS. Only brands we can verify through the ad library, LinkedIn or a reference.

2. YOUR PROCESS. Describe your creative strategy process step by step, from research to live ad to learning. How you find angles, how you d
 what gets tested, how you brief makers, how you judge a winner, and how a loss feeds the next round. Your own words, not the name of a framework.

3. PORTFOLIO. Links to five ads you strategized that won, with the numbers behind each one.

4. ONE LOSS. A concept you were sure about that died, and what it taught you.

5. RATE AND START. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test assignment of 2 to 3 hours, paid also if we do not continue. After that, two interviews and reference calls.



Generic applications and applications that skip the five points are deleted without reply.

title: Operations VA
description:

The job:

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Operations VA to help manage the day-to-day systems and internal operations of a growing marketing and creative agency.



This role is ideal for someone who is extremely detail-oriented, comfortable working with technology, and naturally looks for ways to make processes cleaner, faster, and more reliable.



You will work closely with the founder and help ensure that the business operates smoothly behind the scenes. This is not a traditional virtual assistant role where you simply wait for tasks to be assigned. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring responsibilities, identify problems before they become larger issues, and help build systems as the company grows.









Your responsibilities may include:

* Maintaining and organizing our internal CRM, pipelines, contacts, tags, and customer data

* Helping improve existing systems rather than simply maintaining them

* Supporting additional administrative and operational projects as the company grows
