title: Digitizer
description:
D2S Apparel is looking for an experienced Embroidery Digitizer to join our team remotely. We are a busy custom apparel company producing embroidery for businesses, schools, sports teams, organizations, and other customers.



We are looking for someone who understands production embroidery, not simply how to digitize an image. The right person needs to understand how a design will actually sew on different garments and materials.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for creating clean, production-ready embroidery files using Wilcom EmbroideryStudio.



Your work will include:



Digitizing logos and custom artwork from vector and raster files



Creating files for left chest, hats, jackets, polos, bags, hoodies, uniforms, and other garments



Digitizing specifically for structured and unstructured caps



Creating 3D/puff embroidery



Creating standard flat embroidery



Adjusting designs based on garment type, fabric, size, and placement



Selecting the proper stitch types, densities, underlay, pull compensation, sequencing, and stitch direction



Properly using satin, fill/tatami, run, triple run, motif and other stitch types



Minimizing unnecessary trims, jumps, and color changes



Understanding push/pull distortion and how different materials affect embroidery



Creating clean small lettering and detailed logos



Preparing files that run efficiently on commercial embroidery machines



Making revisions when necessary based on sew-out results



Providing Wilcom source files along with production-ready machine files



Required Experience



Wilcom EmbroideryStudio experience is REQUIRED.



We are specifically looking for someone who:



Is highly proficient in Wilcom EmbroideryStudio



Has professional embroidery digitizing experience



Understands the difference between digitizing for flats and caps



Has strong experience with cap digitizing



Understands proper center-out sequencing for hats



Has experience creating 3D/puff embroidery



Understands foam, stitch density, edge coverage, and techniques required for clean puff embroidery



Understands different fabric types and how digitizing must change for each



Can identify and properly use different stitch types



Understands underlay, density, compensation, stitch angles, tie-ins/tie-offs, trims, and sequencing



Can work from AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPG, and other common artwork formats



Has strong attention to detail



Can communicate clearly in English



Can meet deadlines and handle multiple designs



What We're Looking For



We do not want someone who simply uses auto-digitizing and sends the file.



We want a digitizer who understands embroidery production and can look at a logo and determine the best way to make it sew cleanly.



You should be comfortable making decisions such as:



Satin vs. fill stitches



Proper underlay for the material



Correct stitch direction



Density adjustments for different fabrics



Small-lettering techniques



Cap-friendly sequencing



When artwork needs to be simplified for embroidery



How to build clean borders



How to digitize specifically for 3D puff



How to reduce thread breaks, unnecessary trims, and excessive stitch counts while maintaining quality



Our goal is to send you artwork and receive back a file that is ready for production with minimal adjustments.



Equipment



Our embroidery department operates commercial Barudan embroidery machines, so experience digitizing for Barudan equipment is a plus.



To Apply



Please send us:



A brief description of your embroidery digitizing experience



How many years you have used Wilcom EmbroideryStudio



Which version of Wilcom you currently use



Examples of your digitizing work



Examples of hat/cap digitizing



Examples of 3D/puff embroidery



Examples of small lettering and detailed logos



Your typical turnaround time



Your availability and preferred working hours



Your expected hourly or monthly rate



IMPORTANT: Please include screenshots from Wilcom showing the actual digitized files/stitch objects for at least two of your samples. We want to evaluate the digitizing itself, not only photographs of finished embroidery.

title: L2/L3 Support Engineer - Infrastructure Hosting (Remote, Senior)
description:
L2/L3 Support Engineer - Infrastructure Hosting (Remote, Senior)



FDC Servers runs bare metal, VPS, and network infrastructure across more than thirty locations in North America, Europe, and Asia. Real hardware, real clients, and real consequences when it goes down.



This role is the end of the line on the technical side. When a ticket has been through two people and still isn't solved, it comes to you. When a client's packet loss doesn't show up in any obvious place, you're the one who finds it. When the same failure has happened four times, you're the one who works out why and makes it stop.



It's the depth track rather than the management track. You'll mentor and you'll set the technical standard, but nobody is asking you to run a rota or write performance reviews.



We're hiring across the L2 and L3 band. Level is set at offer based on what you demonstrate.



COMPENSATION: USD $2,200-$3,000/month, depending on experience. Full-time, 40 hours/week.

SCHEDULE: Shift-based with coverage expectations, weekend rotation shared across the team. More scheduling flexibility than our L1/L2 roles.

REPORTS TO: FDC support tech lead.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

- Own the problems nobody else could close. Intermittent packet loss, hardware that fails only under load, boot failures with no obvious cause, performance problems that aren't where the client thinks they are.

- Diagnose at the network layer and interpret what you find. MTR analysis, packet capture, DHCP and PXE failure signatures, routing behavior, throughput testing across sites.

- Turn one-off fixes into permanent ones: a runbook, a KB article, or an AWX job template so the L1s solve it themselves next time. We measure this.

- Build and extend the tooling. We run automation in AWX and Ansible: multi-site iperf3 throughput testing, NIC tuning, PXE boot diagnostics with packet-level tracing, firmware version tracking. You'll add to them.

- Set the technical standard by example. Your notes, escalations, and client writing are what the L1s copy.

- Be the second pair of eyes on remote hands scope before a technician drives to a data center.

- Escalate outward when it really is beyond us: vendor escalation, network team, hardware RMA, with the evidence assembled.



YOU DON'T NEED A HOSTING BACKGROUND, AND YOU MAY NOT NEED THE TITLE EITHER

We're looking for demonstrated depth, not a specific job history, and we're not counting years. Backgrounds that work well here:

- NOC or ISP engineering. If you've chased packet loss across a transit provider's network, you already do the hardest part of this job.

- A serious homelab or self-hosted setup. Multiple hypervisors, a segmented network, BGP at home because you wanted to understand it.

- You were the whole IT department somewhere. Everything from the switch config to the backups was yours.

- Open source or community work. You maintain something, you answer hard questions in a forum or 
.

- Adjacent engineering: SRE, DevOps, systems, platform. The hardware is learnable. The diagnostic instinct is the hard part.

- Self-taught, with no degree and no certs. That works. We test directly.



If you're strong but have never held a senior title because the org never had one to give you, please apply. That's a common shape and it isn't a mark against you.



TECHNICAL BASELINE (this is what we test)

- Linux, deeply. Not just navigating. Diagnosing: what's consuming the resource, why the service won't start, what the kernel is complaining about, and how to prove it.

- Networking, properly. Routing, VLANs, MTU and fragmentation, reading an MTR and knowing what asymmetry means, packet capture and analysis, DHCP and PXE mechanics. BGP concepts a strong plus.

- Hardware failure modes. SMART data and what predicts failure, RAID controller behavior, NVMe/SAS/SATA differences that matter in practice, memory and thermal faults, IPMI and BMC.

- Automation. Scripting at minimum. Ansible, or the ability to pick it up quickly.

- Written English strong enough to be the escalation standard. You'll write the notes other people learn from.



NICE TO HAVE: Proxmox VE at scale, Kubernetes/Docker/Ceph, runbooks or KB material others actually used, data center operations exposure, any language beyond scripting.



WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU APPLY

This isn't a step into meetings, and it isn't a role where you stop touching tickets. A large part of it is making yourself less necessary: writing down what you know and automating what you repeat, so the team can solve next time what you solved this time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a CV. Then send us something that shows depth, because a CV usually doesn't. Any one of: a war story with the diagnostic path (a hard problem, what you thought it was, what the evidence said, how you proved the real cause - the wrong turns are the interesting part); something you built (a tool, script, playbook, repo, or homelab you can describe in detail); or something you wrote (a runbook, postmortem, KB article, or long technical answer).



HOW WE HIRE

A written technical exercise, then a live interview that goes deep on real scenarios rather than trivia. "I don't know, here's how I'd find out" is a good answer here. We tell you yes or no either way, with the reason.



Note: We only review applications from ID-verified OnlineJobs.ph accounts.

title: L1/L2 Support Operations Technician - Server Provisioning (Remote)
description:
L1/L2 Support Operations Technician - Server Provisioning (Remote)



FDC Servers runs bare metal infrastructure across more than thirty data centers in North America, Europe, and Asia. Before any server reaches a customer, it has to be built and proven: hardware detected and verified, disks sanitized, firmware checked, health validated under our automated pipeline. Hundreds of machines move through that pipeline every month, and every one that passes becomes sellable inventory the same week.



You'd be one of the technicians running it. Working through IPMI and BMC consoles, driving network boot and automated install flows, reading SMART data and hardware detection output, d
 whether a failure is a bad disk, a dead cable, a firmware mismatch, or a process problem, and moving each machine to a real disposition rather than letting it sit.



Everything is remote and internal-facing. There's no customer contact in this role. Your writing goes to teammates and engineers, so we care that your notes are clear and complete rather than polished.



We're hiring across the L1 and L2 band. Where you land is set at offer, based on what you show us rather than on your last title.



COMPENSATION: USD $1,000-$2,400/month, depending on experience. Full-time, 40 hours/week.

SCHEDULE: Shift-based, weekday-weighted with some weekend rotation.

REPORTS TO: FDC support operations, with a named mentor for your first 90 days.



THE PART OF THE JOB THAT MATTERS MOST

Running the pipeline is the job description. Finding the patterns is where the value is.



If the same wipe failure shows up three times in a week, we'd like to hear about it, with the evidence, before anyone asks. If a batch of machines from one vendor keeps failing hardware detection the same way, that observation is worth more to us than a hundred routine passes. The technicians who grow fastest here are the ones who notice, say something, and propose the fix.



That shapes what we measure. We look at machines moved to real outcomes and at patterns found, not at hours logged or actions taken. If a wipe keeps failing, we'd much rather you stop and ask why than retry it forty times, and you'll never be penalized for pausing to investigate. Making a problem disappear permanently is the most valuable thing you can do here, and it's what we notice at review time.



YOU DON'T NEED A DATA CENTER BACKGROUND

We care about what you can do more than where you learned it. Backgrounds that work well here:

- You run a homelab. Secondhand servers, a NAS you built, Proxmox VE or ESXi, machines you've flashed, bricked, and recovered.

- You've built or repaired PCs seriously: diagnosing dead boards, reading POST behavior, knowing why a machine won't boot.

- You've administered game servers or community infrastructure where real users noticed downtime.

- NOC, field tech, or repair bench experience at an ISP, telco, or shop.

- Self-taught, with no degree, having learned by breaking things in a VM and reading documentation. That works. We test skills rather than paperwork.



TECHNICAL BASELINE (this is what we test)

- Hardware. Server components and how they fail. Disk types and interfaces, SMART attributes and what predicts failure, RAID basics, memory and thermal faults, BIOS and UEFI configuration.

- Boot and management planes. IPMI or equivalent BMC access, console redirection, network boot fundamentals (what has to happen between power-on and an OS installer starting).

- Linux command line. Comfortable reading logs, running diagnostics, following a runbook precisely, and knowing when what you're seeing means the runbook doesn't apply.

- Written English clear enough for a teammate to act on. This is not a customer-facing role, and accent or polish plays no part in the screen.



NICE TO HAVE: PXE/DHCP/network-boot troubleshooting, firmware update experience on NICs/drives/BMCs, any scripting, Ansible exposure or curiosity about it. Certifications aren't required - we test the baseline directly.



WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU APPLY

This isn't piecework, and volume of activity on its own isn't what gets noticed here. We can see the difference between forty retries and one diagnosis, and it's the diagnosis we reward. The role does ask you to speak up when something looks wrong, including when nobody has asked you.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a CV if you have one. Then send the thing that really gets our attention, one of: a description of your homelab or bench (what's in it, what broke, how you figured out why); a war story - the worst hardware problem you've chased, what you thought it was, and what it turned out to be; or something you automated or scripted, however small. Two or three paragraphs is plenty.



HOW WE HIRE

A written screening exercise first, then a live technical interview with scenario questions about real failures. "I don't know, here's how I'd find out" is a good answer here. We tell you yes or no either way, with the reason.



Note: We only review applications from ID-verified OnlineJobs.ph accounts.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Position Overview:

We're looking for a strong, self-directed Accounting Manager to own the full financial operations of two service companies under one parent LLC. This is not a data-entry role. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate every day, making sure payroll and payroll taxes are handled correctly, tracking our debt obligations, and giving the Owner a clear picture of profitability and cash flow. The right person spots problems before they become problems and works without being told what to do next. This role reports directly to the Owner.



Key Responsibilities:



Daily Bookkeeping & Reconciliation



Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts daily using QuickBooks bank feeds, and categorize transactions accurately.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies the same day they appear.

Maintain clean, separate books for two entities.



Payroll & Payroll Taxes



Process weekly/bi-weekly payroll accurately and on schedule.

Calculate, file, and pay US payroll taxes on time, including federal withholding, FICA, FUTA (Form 940), quarterly Form 941, NC state withholding, and NC unemployment.

Maintain payroll tax deposit schedules and make sure there are zero late filings or penalties.



Job Profitability



Track and report profitability by job, service type, and client for both residential and commercial services.

Analyze labor, supply, and overhead costs against job revenue, and flag underperforming jobs or pricing issues to the Owner.



Cash Flow Forecasting



Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.

Project upcoming obligations (payroll, taxes, loan remittances, vendor bills) and alert the Owner to potential shortfalls in advance.



Debt & Financing Management



Properly record and track merchant cash advances (MCAs) and Stripe Capital loans, including the original balance, fees/factor rates, and daily or weekly remittances.

Reconcile loan balances to lender statements and maintain an accurate payoff schedule for every financing obligation.



AP, AR & Reporting



Manage accounts receivable, monitor due dates, and follow up on outstanding invoices.

Process accounts payable on time or ahead of schedule, and maintain an organized vendor and approval system.

Complete month-end close and deliver monthly financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with a written summary for the Owner.

Assist with budgeting and expense management.

Coordinate with our CPA for quarterly and annual filings.



Qualifications:



5+ years of experience in accounting or bookkeeping, including managing books independently.

Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks, including bank feeds, rules, classes, and reporting.

Proven working knowledge of US federal and state payroll tax calculation, filing, and deposits.

Experience tracking business loans and financing, with MCA and/or Stripe Capital experience strongly preferred.

Experience building cash flow forecasts and job-costing or profitability reports.

Ability to work independently, manage your own deadlines, and bring solutions rather than questions.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

High integrity with confidential financial information.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.



Preferred Skills:



Experience in service-based businesses, especially cleaning, home services, or field service.

Multi-entity bookkeeping experience.

Familiarity with Profit First.

Experience working on an EOS team (Scorecards, Rocks).

title: Senior Web / UI Designer (Figma) for Premium Events Brand
description:
Senior Web / UI Designer (Figma) for Premium Events Brand



Project Type: Fixed-price project

Budget: ₱60,000–₱125,000 PHP

Design Platform: Figma

Development Required: No

Working Hours: Must have regular overlap with Toronto, Canada business hours



About Snaptique



Snaptique is a Canadian photo booth and experiential event company working across weddings, corporate events and brand activations.



We have an established website, brand, products, photography and substantial existing content. We are looking for an experienced senior web/UI designer to redesign our website in Figma and create a more polished, premium and cohesive visual system.



This is not a rebrand. We are not looking for a new logo or a completely new identity.



Our goal is to elevate the website so Snaptique feels more like a premium creative and experiential brand while remaining easy to navigate, conversion-focused and SEO-friendly.



The Project



We need a designer to create the core website experience and a reusable design system in Figma.



Rather than designing every page individually, we want a flexible system that can be reused across our products, locations, projects and content.



We expect approximately 9 to 10 core page types:



* Homepage

* Photo Booths / Product Collection page

* Individual Photo Booth page template

* Weddings page

* Corporate / Brand Activations page

* Locations hub

* Individual Location page template

* Project / Case Study template

* Blog / Article template

* Inquiry / Contact page

* Global navigation and footer



You do NOT need to design every individual booth or location page.



For example, our Classic, Retro, Modern, Vintage and other photo booths should use the same flexible product-page system.



Our Toronto, Vancouver, Niagara and other location pages should also use a scalable location-page system.



Design System



We want more than a collection of individual page mockups.



The final Figma file should include a reusable design system covering elements such as:



* Typography

* Colour usage

* Buttons and text links

* Navigation

* Product cards

* Location cards

* Project and case study cards

* Image galleries

* Testimonials

* Client and brand logo sections

* Calls to action

* FAQ and accordion sections

* Forms

* Blog cards

* Related content

* Footer

* Spacing and layout rules



Components should be organized and reusable so future pages can be created without redesigning the website each time.



Desktop + Mobile



Responsive design is important to us.



Core page templates must include both desktop and mobile designs.



We are not looking for someone who designs desktop screens and leaves the mobile experience undefined for the developer.



The mobile experience should be intentionally designed.



Multi-City Website



Snaptique operates in multiple Canadian markets, including Toronto and Vancouver, with additional locations and markets planned.



The design needs to allow Snaptique to feel like a national brand while still feeling local when someone visits a city-specific page.



For this phase, we only need the design to account for a simple location selector within the global navigation, for example:



Toronto ▾



Advanced geolocation, cookies, automatic location switching and dynamic functionality are NOT part of this project.



We simply want the website structure to be capable of supporting these features in the future without requiring a complete redesign.



SEO Is Important



Our website has an established SEO strategy and substantial existing content.



You will NOT be responsible for SEO strategy, keyword research or writing SEO copy.



However, your designs must accommodate:



* H1, H2 and H3 content hierarchy

* Meaningful body copy

* Product descriptions

* Location-specific content

* Internal links

* FAQs

* Galleries

* Related products

* Case studies

* Blog content

* Calls to action



We are not looking for a design approach that makes the website look cleaner simply by deleting most of the content.



Part of the design challenge is making substantial content feel organized, premium and easy to read.



Visual Direction



Snaptique should feel like a premium creative and events brand rather than a typical photo booth rental website.



We value:



* Strong typography

* Editorial-style layouts

* Excellent use of photography

* Thoughtful whitespace

* Clear visual hierarchy

* Interesting layouts without sacrificing usability

* Premium brand presentation

* Strong mobile design

* Subtle interaction ideas

* Clear conversion paths



Our work spans weddings, luxury venues, corporate events and experiential brand activations. The design needs to work across all of these audiences while still feeling like one cohesive brand.



We have extensive professional event and product photography available.



What We Will Provide



We will provide:



* Existing website

* Existing logo and brand assets

* Brand colours

* Extensive professional event photography

* Product photography

* Existing website copy

* SEO page structure and content

* Product information

* Location strategy

* Examples of websites and design styles we like

* Regular feedback throughout the project



You will not be starting from a blank slate.



What This Project Does NOT Include



You will NOT be responsible for:



* Website development

* Coding

* Website migration

* SEO strategy

* Keyword research

* Copywriting

* Logo design

* Full rebranding

* Designing every individual product page

* Designing every individual city page

* Geolocation development

* Cookie or location-switching development



This is a Figma UX/UI and visual website design project only.



Who We’re Looking For



We are specifically looking for a senior-level designer.



This is not a junior design position or a project for someone who is still learning Figma.



You should be comfortable:



* Making strong design decisions independently

* Explaining the reasoning behind those decisions

* Working with an established content and SEO structure

* Designing content-heavy pages without making them feel cluttered

* Creating reusable components and design systems

* Working with high-quality photography

* Designing both desktop and mobile experiences

* Receiving and implementing detailed feedback

* Keeping a Figma project organized for eventual developer handoff



Experience designing marketing, service, hospitality, luxury, fashion, beauty, creative agency, events or experiential websites is particularly relevant.



Portfolio Requirement



Your portfolio must contain strong website design work.



We are primarily interested in marketing and brand websites.



If your portfolio consists mainly of SaaS dashboards, mobile apps or admin interfaces, this project is probably not the right fit.



Strong visual judgment and art direction are very important to us.



Toronto Working Hours



This requirement is important.



Although we are happy to work with a designer based in the Philippines, our team is located in the Toronto, Canada time zone.



The selected designer must be comfortable maintaining regular working-hour overlap with Toronto Monday through Friday for communication, feedback and scheduled meetings.



We expect approximately 4 hours of reliable overlap with Toronto business hours on working days during active phases of the project.



You do not need to work your entire schedule on Toronto time, but we do not want a workflow where questions and feedback require waiting until the following day because our schedules never overlap.



Please only apply if this working arrangement is suitable for you.



Project Structure



This will be a fixed-price project with milestone payments.



We expect the project to follow approximately this structure:



Milestone 1: Visual direction + initial homepage concept



Milestone 2: Approved homepage design



Milestone 3: Core page templates + design system



Milestone 4: Mobile and responsive designs



Milestone 5: Final revisions + organized Figma handoff



Exact milestone amounts and deliverables will be agreed upon before the project begins.



Budget



₱60,000–₱125,000 PHP fixed project



This is not a lowest-bid project.



We are looking for an experienced designer with a strong portfolio and excellent visual judgment. Our decision will be based primarily on the quality and relevance of your work, your approach to the project, communication and ability to execute the complete design system.



Please provide your proposed fixed project price within this range based on the scope above.



We are not looking for an open-ended hourly arrangement.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



1. A link to your website/Figma design portfolio.

2. Show us the ONE website project in your portfolio that you believe is most relevant to Snaptique and briefly explain why.

3. Your proposed fixed project price in PHP.

4. Your estimated timeline for completing the project.

5. Confirmation that your quote includes both desktop and mobile designs.

6. A brief explanation of how you normally organize a design system and final Figma handoff.

7. Tell us whether you personally created the portfolio work you are sharing or whether it was completed as part of a larger team.

8. Confirm that you can provide approximately 4 hours of overlap with Toronto business hours Monday through Friday during active project phases.



Please begin your application with the words:



SNAPTIQUE FIGMA



This lets us know you have read the complete project description.



Generic applications, hourly proposals and applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

title: Client Success Specialist (Ecommerce Fulfillment)
description:
We are a growing ecommerce fulfillment and logistics company helping brands manage warehousing, order fulfillment, freight forwarding, and product sourcing.



We are hiring Client Success Specialists to support our clients, solve problems, and keep them informed as their products move from factory to customer.



Read this entire post before applying. This is a demanding, high-pressure role with strict expectations for responsiveness, accuracy, availability, and productivity.



THE ROLE



You will work across multiple systems, communication channels, and AI tools while helping support 50+ clients. You must learn quickly, stay organized, prioritize competing requests, and remain calm when several urgent issues happen at once.



Responsibilities include:



• Responding to client messages across Slack, WhatsApp,
, and our portal, with an initial response within five minutes during your shift.

• Answering calls and joining client or internal meetings with your camera on, as needed during working hours.

• Investigating delayed orders, shipping problems, inventory discrepancies, product setup issues, and store connection errors.

• Coordinating with warehouse operations, Client Success leadership, developers, and accounting to resolve issues.

• Creating clear tickets, documenting bugs, tracking follow-ups, and keeping clients updated until each issue is closed.

• Maintaining accurate client records, product information, packing instructions, and task status.

• Supporting onboarding tasks, inbound shipment coordination, and client changes as assigned.

• Using AI tools and AI agents to research, organize, troubleshoot, and work efficiently. You remain responsible for verifying the accuracy of your work.



Acknowledging a message is only the first step. You must follow through, communicate next steps, and make sure nothing gets lost.



NONNEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



Excellent English

You must speak, type, read, and understand English fluently and accurately, including during fast-moving calls and detailed written conversations.



Full commitment

This must be your only job. Our employment agreement will prohibit holding another job or performing outside freelance or contractor work while employed with us. Violating that requirement will be a breach of your agreement. The workload and availability expectations make juggling multiple jobs unsustainable.



Consistent availability

During your scheduled working hours, you must be reachable and ready to answer calls, join meetings with your camera on, and respond to urgent requests.



Accountability

You will work on a company-provided computer with time tracking and activity monitoring to verify productivity.



Live collaboration

On many workdays, you will be required to remain connected to an internal Slack huddle or Google Meet while working so the team can coordinate and solve problems quickly.



Strong organization

You must manage multiple conversations, deadlines, and open issues without needing repeated reminders.



Fast learning

You must be comfortable learning unfamiliar software, following procedures, receiving direct feedback, and adapting quickly.



TRAINING AND AVAILABLE SHIFTS



All hires must complete two weeks of training, Monday through Friday, from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM Central Time, regardless of their permanent shift.



We are filling three permanent schedules:



• Morning: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–3:00 PM.

• Afternoon and evening: Monday–Friday, 3:00 PM–12:00 AM midnight.

• Weekend coverage: Thursday–Monday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. Off Tuesdays and Wednesdays.



All schedules follow U.S. Central Time, including daylight saving changes.



EXPERIENCE THAT HELPS



Experience in ecommerce, fulfillment, logistics, customer support, or account support is a strong advantage.



Familiarity with Warehance, ShipHero, ShipStation, Shopify, Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, Gmail, Google Drive, Quo, and Slack is a plus. You do not need experience with every platform, but you must be comfortable working across several tools throughout the day.



GROWTH AND EARNING OPPORTUNITIES



This is a fast-paced position with high standards and meaningful responsibility. Strong performers will have opportunities for substantial income growth, performance bonuses, and expanded responsibilities based on results.



HOW TO APPLY



We are conducting group interviews this week. To apply, reply with:



1. Confirmation that you read this entire post and understand the schedule, exclusivity, monitoring, and performance expectations.

2. Why you are a strong fit for this role.

3. Your personal five-year goals.

4. Your relevant experience and the tools you have used.

5. Your preferred permanent shift and confirmation that you can attend the required two-week training schedule.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



GET CONSIDERED FASTER



For faster consideration, include a Loom video with your application. In the video:



• Show your face and introduce yourself.

• Explain why you are a strong fit for this role.

• Share your screen and take a typing test live so we can see your typing speed and accuracy. Show the final results.

• Describe your workstation, including your computer, monitors, headset, and whether you have a quiet, dedicated workspace.

• Explain how reliable your internet and power are, how often you experience outages, and what backup options you have.



Keep your camera on and speak in English throughout the recording. Make sure your Loom link is accessible without requesting permission.

title: Website Content Editor (Fluent English, Loves Writing) — US Medical Marketing Agency
description:
We are Pilot Practice (KloudMD) — a US company that builds software and marketing systems for medical practices (med spas, dentists, plastic surgeons, therapists).



This is a WRITING and EDITING job. You will own the words on our clients' websites: blog posts, service pages, homepages, landing pages. You are not a VA, not a designer, not a social-media poster. If you do not genuinely enjoy reading and writing in English, this is not your seat.



WHO WE NEED

Someone smart, fluent in English, who reads for pleasure and writes clearly without being told twice.



Most of the first draft is generated by our AI tools. Your job is to be the human who makes it good: cut the fluff, fix what is wrong or generic, make it sound like the specific doctor's office it belongs to, and make sure nothing goes live that would embarrass the client. You will also write from scratch when the AI draft is not usable.



You need taste. You should be able to read two paragraphs about "Botox in Scottsdale" and tell us in one sentence why one is better than the other.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Edit AI-drafted blog posts and service pages in our content editor before they publish. Grammar, flow, accuracy, tone, and "does this actually say anything."

- Write blogs and service pages from a brief (target keyword, the practice's real facts, what already ranks on Google). No filler, no made-up claims, no "in today's fast-paced world."

- Review new pages visually before they go
 headline reads right, sections make sense, calls to action say the right thing, nothing looks broken on mobile.

- Work the change queue: clients and our team leave comments on live pages ("change this sentence", "this photo is wrong"). You make the edit or answer the question, and close the loop.

- Keep each client's voice consistent across their site. A plastic surgeon and a family therapist do not sound the same.

- Flag medical or legal landmines: guaranteed results, before/after claims without disclaimers, fake urgency, anything a US medical board would not like.

- Send drafts to clients for approval and chase the approval politely until it is done.



MUST HAVE

- Fluent, natural written English. Not "good enough." A US doctor should not be able to tell the page was not written in the US.

- You like reading and writing. Tell us what you read last month (books, long articles, anything). We will ask.

- You can edit ruthlessly. Cutting 40% of a draft and making it better is normal work for you.

- You catch details: a wrong phone number, a service the practice does not offer, a heading that promises something the page never delivers.

- Comfortable in WordPress at the level of editing a page and swapping an image. We have tools for the hard parts.

- Overlap with Arizona, USA (MST): at least 4 hours between 8am and 5pm Arizona time. 40 hours/week.

- Camera-on video interview and a short live editing test on a shared screen.



NICE TO HAVE

- SEO writing experience: search intent, headings, meta titles, internal links.

- Healthcare, medical, dental, or med-spa content.

- Experience editing AI output rather than pretending it does not exist.

- Basic understanding of what makes a landing page convert.



PAY

$600 USD/month. Full time, 40 hours/week. Paid 4-hour trial task before any long-term offer. Paid on time, every month, via your preferred method.



HOW WE THINK — A REAL EXAMPLE (READ THIS)

An AI draft for a dermatology client opened with: "In today's fast-paced world, healthy skin is more important than ever. Our team of dedicated professionals is committed to providing top-notch care."



That paragraph says nothing. It could be on any website on earth. A good editor deletes it and replaces it with the one thing that practice actually does differently — in this case, the doctor sees every patient herself and does not hand you to a nurse for injectables. That is the sentence that gets a booking.



If that example made you nod, apply. If you think the original paragraph was fine, please do not.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly — we use it to filter)

1. Start your application with the word "LAVENDER" so we know you read the whole post.

2. Rewrite the bad dermatology paragraph above in your own words, 2 to 3 sentences, for a practice where the differentiator is same-week appointments.

3. In 100 to 150 words, tell us about something you read recently and why it stuck with you. Your own words. Do not use AI for this — we will talk about it on the call and it will be obvious.

4. Your available hours in Arizona time.

5. Links to 2 or 3 things you have written or edited, if you have them. If you do not, say so; item 2 and 3 matter more.



Applications that skip step 1 or paste a generic cover letter are not read. We hire the person who can make a page better on a shared screen, not the person with the fanciest resume.

How to Apply

 us the application. Do not text us. Just use this website for applying.

Then answer these questions:

2. Which of the following have you used professionally: Google Docs, Google Sheets, Dubsado, Calendly, ChatGPT, or other AI tools? Briefly describe your level of experience.

3. Tell us about a piece of software you had never used before but had to learn quickly. How did you learn it?

4. Give us one specific example of how you have used AI to make your work better or faster. Please tell us what you did—not simply which AI tool you used.

title: UK B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — AI Receptionist Company
description:
NetHive provides premium AI voice receptionist systems to UK service businesses.

Our AI receptionist answers incoming calls, handles common enquiries, captures leads, helps with appointment booking, and supports businesses with missed, overflow and after-hours calls.

We are currently focused on independent UK aesthetics / cosmetic clinics.

We are looking for an experienced B2B cold caller / appointment setter who can confidently speak with UK businesses, get past gatekeepers, reach owners/managers and book qualified demonstrations.

This is not a hard-closing role.

Your main responsibility is to create interest and book qualified appointments. The founder will personally handle demonstrations, proposals and closing.

What you’ll do

Make outbound calls to pre-qualified UK aesthetics clinics

Ask for and speak with owners, founders, clinic directors, medical directors or other decision-makers

Introduce NetHive clearly and naturally

Identify whether the clinic experiences missed, overflow or after-hours calls

Create enough interest for the prospect to see or try our AI receptionist

Book qualified demonstrations

Record call outcomes and useful notes accurately

Follow up with prospects when required

Handle common objections without sounding scripted or aggressive

You will NOT be expected to spend your day searching for leads. We will provide researched prospect lists including clinic information and, where available, the decision-maker’s name.

Compensation

We want the compensation to reward quality, not meaningless call volume.

Starting compensation:

$6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and communication ability.

PLUS:

+$10–$15 for each qualified demo that actually attends

+$50 for each customer you sourced who becomes a paying NetHive client and completes their first payment

Bonuses are additional to your hourly pay.

High-performing callers may receive increased hours, higher bonuses and greater responsibility as the company grows.

What counts as a qualified appointment?

A qualified appointment should:

Be with an owner, founder, director, manager or person with genuine purchasing authority

Be from a relevant UK aesthetics/cosmetic clinic

Understand broadly what NetHive provides

Have genuine interest in exploring the AI receptionist

Attend the scheduled demonstration

Simply putting an unqualified person on the calendar does not count as a qualified appointment.

Who we’re looking for

You should have:

Previous cold-calling, telemarketing or appointment-setting experience

Excellent spoken English

Clear, confident and natural phone communication

Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

Confidence handling gatekeepers

Ability to think and respond naturally rather than reading a script word-for-word

Good listening skills

Reliable internet and a quiet calling environment

Comfortable using CRM / prospecting software

Strong attendance and reliability

Experience calling UK businesses is a major advantage.

Experience selling SaaS, AI, marketing, appointment-setting, healthcare, beauty/aesthetics or other B2B services is also advantageous.

Working hours

You must be available during UK business hours.

The initial calling block will likely be around 3–4 hours per weekday, scheduled during the portion of the UK working day that produces the best contact rate.

Because you are in the Philippines, this will generally mean working during your late afternoon/evening, with the exact schedule changing slightly when UK daylight-saving time changes.

Important: voice sample required

Please do not send only a generic application.

To apply, include:

1. A short introduction about your cold-calling experience.

2. The types of businesses/countries you have previously called.

3. Your previous appointment-setting results if available.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording.

In the recording, pretend you are calling the owner of a UK aesthetics clinic.

Scenario:

You work for NetHive. We provide an AI receptionist that answers missed, busy and after-hours calls, handles common enquiries and can help customers with appointment booking.

Give us your natural cold-call opening and try to create enough interest to book a short demonstration.

Do not over-script it. We want to hear how you actually sound on a call.

Also include the word “IVY” somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire job post.

Hiring process

Shortlisted candidates will have a brief interview followed by a live cold-call roleplay.

The successful candidate will begin with a paid two-week trial using real prospect lists.

We are looking for someone who can potentially work with us long term as NetHive grows.

HMO

title: Advanced U.S. Tax Strategist / Tax Planning Specialist
Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company email

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by email, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

* Follow instructions and documented procedures

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Are comfortable performing both analytical and routine administrative work

* Know when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Enjoy managing cases from beginning to completion

* Want a stable, long-term role with one company

* Respect confidentiality and sensitive client information

* Prefer quality and accuracy over high-volume, rushed work

* Are interested in growing within an organization rather than building a competing advisory practice



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* At least two years of relevant administrative, bookkeeping, accounting, insurance, client-service, or case-management experience

* Strong spreadsheet, email, and document-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Leadership Skills

* Managerial Skills

* Professional telephone presence

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional environment for client calls

* Ability to handle confidential financial information

* Ability to organize multiple cases and deadlines

* Willingness to complete reference and background checks

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, and intellectual-property agreements

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* GoHighLevel or another CRM

* U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* U.S. business financial statements

* U.S. business tax documents

* Client onboarding

* Life-insurance or annuity case processing

* Financial-advisor support

* Tax Strategies

* Project Manager

* Project Coordinator

* DocuSign or secure client portals

* Workflow and implementation tracking

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* 20-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review following successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on performance, accuracy, reliability, and judgment



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow all instructions will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. Complete written responses to the questions below.

4. The words “VLARI Case Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant professional experience

* The types of U.S. clients or companies you have supported

* Your experience with accounting, bookkeeping, client onboarding, insurance, or case management

* Why you are comfortable performing both administrative and analytical work

* How you communicate with a client who has not submitted required information

* Why you are interested in a long-term position



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read your résumé. Video-production quality is not important. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, and ability to interact comfortably with clients.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Describe a situation in which you discovered missing or inaccurate information in a client file. What did you do?



2. How do you organize multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines?



3. What accounting, bookkeeping, CRM, project-management, and document-management systems have you used?



4. Describe your experience collecting information or documents from clients.



5. Are you comfortable making and receiving professional client calls? Please describe your experience.



6. How would you follow up with a client who has not responded to two document requests?



7. What would you do if a client asked you a technical question that you were not trained or authorized to answer?



8. Are you comfortable performing scheduling, email follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid assessment using fictional client information

* Draft a sample client email

* Review a sample file for missing information

* Prepare a brief internal case summary

* Participate in a mock client call

*

* TikTok

AI PRESENTER AND VIDEO PRODUCTION

title: Junior Organic Content Strategist + Editor | Social Media, YouTube & Video
description:
Hello, we're looking for a full-time Junior Organic Content Strategist + Editor to help grow a founder's personal brand through social media, YouTube, and video content.



This role combines content strategy, research, scripting, and hands-on video editing.



You'll help figure out what we should create, develop the idea and script, and turn recordings into finished long-form and short-form content.



You don't need to be an expert at everything. We're looking for someone motivated, curious, creative, and eager to become very good at both content strategy and editing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research topics, creators, competitors, trends, and content formats

• Find interesting content ideas, angles, and hooks

• Help develop YouTube topics, titles, outlines, and scripts

• Help write short-form scripts and hooks

• Edit long-form YouTube videos

• Edit Reels, Shorts, and other short-form content

• Find strong moments from long-form recordings to turn into clips

• Repurpose content across YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms

• Help organize the content calendar

• Review content performance and identify patterns

• Suggest new content ideas based on what is working

• Help improve the organic content system over time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong interest in social media, YouTube, and organic content

• Good writing and communication skills

• Strategic and creative thinking

• Good understanding of hooks, storytelling, and attention

• Basic to intermediate video editing skills

• Strong research skills

• Good eye for what makes content interesting

• Comfortable using AI tools

• Strong attention to detail

• Reliable and organized



Editing tools



Experience with one or more of these is a plus:

• CapCut

• DaVinci Resolve

• Premiere Pro

• Canva

• Figma



You don't need to know all of them. We're more interested in your ability to learn and create.



Bonus if you have experience with:

• YouTube

• Instagram / Reels

• TikTok / Shorts

• LinkedIn

• Scriptwriting

• Personal brands

• Content strategy



PERSONALITY MATTERS



We're looking for someone who is hungry to improve.



You should naturally notice good content and ask:

Why did this work?

Why did people keep watching?

What could we do differently?

How can we turn one piece of content into five more?



You don't need to have built a successful personal brand before.



We want someone who is proactive, coachable, curious, and genuinely excited about becoming very good at content.



Over time, we'd like you to become someone who can take an idea from:



Research → Idea → Hook → Script → Video → Repurposing → Distribution → Learning



SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours/week

Monday to Friday

Remote

You'll work with an international team and join 3 team calls per week.



COMPENSATION

₱30,000/month (~$500 USD) starting salary



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. What social media platforms do you understand best?

2. What video editing software do you use and how experienced are you with it?

3. Have you created, scripted, or edited content before? Tell us briefly about it.

4. Please share examples of your work.

5. Pick one creator or personal brand you think does organic content extremely well. What do you think they're doing differently?



IMPORTANT



Start your application with the word Organic on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



TRIAL TASK



Shortlisted applicants may complete a small paid trial task involving content research, scripting, and video editing.



The task will help us evaluate your thinking, creativity, editing ability, attention to detail, and ability to follow a brief.



GROWTH PATH



As you grow, you'll take more ownership over content strategy, research, scripting, YouTube, editing, short-form content, repurposing, and organic growth.



We don't promise promotions or timelines. Growth depends on your performance, skills, and ability to take ownership.



If you're motivated to become genuinely great at content and want to help build a personal brand from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

title: E-commerce Recruiter
description:

You'll work directly with our HR Manager and founders to keep both contractor and full-time pipelines full of strong, vetted candidates.



This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a coordination-only role. You'll source proactively, run structured screens, and bring sharp judgment to who's actually a fit. In DTC, the gap between someone who ran an ad account and someone who sat next to one is enormous, and we need you to be able to tell the difference on a 30-minute call.



What You'll Do



Manage full-cycle recruitment across DTC e-commerce functions: paid media buying, growth, creative strategy, retention/email, Shopify and CRO, analytics, and e-commerce ops

Write and refine job descriptions that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones

How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief

title: Head of Paid Media
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.



We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role: 



You'll take full ownership of paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin, managing $3–5M in monthly spend.



This is a strategy and ownership role. You'll have a team of junior media buyers who handle the implementation, from building and launching campaigns, ad uploads, naming conventions, and day-to-day platform work. title: Customer Support Manager
description:
Customer Support Manager — Fashion E-commerce (US Market)



About the store

We run a general fashion dropshipping store selling to customers in the United States. We scale fast, which means support volume scales fast too. This is one of the most important roles in the company: support d
 whether a customer buys once or buys again, whether a complaint becomes a review or a chargeback, and whether our margins survive the refund line.



The role

You own customer support end to end. Not just answering tickets — building the system that answers them well, hiring and coaching the people who run it, and being accountable for the numbers it produces.



You report directly to the owner. If support is working, it's because of you. If it isn't, you're the one who fixes it.



What you'll own:



The system



Design and maintain the full support workflow: helpdesk setup, macros, tagging, routing, escalation rules

Write and maintain the SOPs and policy documents — refunds, returns, replacements, exceptions, edge cases

Build the FAQ, canned replies and tone-of-voice guide so every reply sounds like one brand

Set up AI-assisted workflows (Claude / ChatGPT) that speed the team up without making replies sound robotic



The team



Manage, coach and quality-check the customer service reps

Run ticket reviews and give concrete feedback, not vague notes

Onboard and train new agents; help hire when we expand

Build the schedule so US hours are properly covered



The numbers



Own the support KPIs: first response time, resolution time, CSAT, refund rate, chargeback rate, dispute win rate, tickets per order

Report weekly to the owner: what moved, why, and what you're doing about it

Drive tickets per order down by fixing the causes — bad product info, unclear shipping expectations, sizing confusion — not just by answering faster

Handle the escalations, disputes and chargebacks the team can't



The feedback loop



Turn support data into action: flag problem products, bad suppliers, misleading listings and recurring complaints

Work with the store manager and the ads side so problems get fixed upstream instead of absorbed downstream



What we're looking for



Several years managing customer support in e-commerce, including at least [1–2] years leading a team — not only handling tickets yourself

Proven experience in a high-volume D2C or dropshipping environment where shipping times and refunds are real pressure points

Excellent written English at native level for a US audience, plus the ability to teach that standard to others

Strong Shopify skills: orders, refunds, fulfillment, reporting

Deep experience with a helpdesk platform ([Gorgias / Zendesk / Freshdesk]) — setup, automations, macros, reporting, not just using it

Proven track record handling PayPal and Stripe disputes and chargebacks, with a win rate you can talk about

Comfortable building structure in Notion, Google Sheets and Slack: SOPs, dashboards, reporting

Confident with Claude / ChatGPT as a workflow tool, with the judgment to know when the output isn't good enough to send

Data-driven: you make decisions from ticket data, not from gut feeling

Calm and decisive under pressure — sale periods, supplier failures, angry escalations

Genuinely organized: nothing gets lost, everything is documented, the system survives without you in the room

Takes full ownership. This role has almost no hand-holding



Nice to have



Experience setting up a support function from scratch or rebuilding a broken one

Fashion or apparel experience (sizing, fit, fabric, returns behavior)

Experience reducing refund or chargeback rates with numbers to back it up



What we offer



Remote, with coverage during [US hours / your timezone]

Full ownership of the support function and the authority to actually change things

Direct line to the owner, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

Long-term role with growth as the store and the team grow



How to apply

Send us:



A short intro: years managing support, team sizes you've led, and the store types you've worked with

A short video introduction of yourself

The KPIs you owned in your last role and what you moved them to

Which helpdesk platform you know best and what you built in it

Answer this: You take over our support today. Tickets per order is high, first response time is over 24 hours, and the refund rate is climbing. You have your first week. Tell us exactly what you do on day 1, in week 1, and in month 1 — and what you'd measure to know it worked.

Start your message with the word OWNERSHIP so we know you read the full post



Applications without the answer to question 4 will not be reviewed.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant role where you simply wait for tasks to be assigned. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring responsibilities, identify problems before they become larger issues, and help build systems as the company grows.









Your responsibilities may include:

* Helping improve existing systems rather than simply maintaining them

GoHighLevel, Xero, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, CRM systems, automation tools, project-management platforms, online advertising dashboards, and reporting software.
